dictionary.def: A reference work on a particular subject or activity in which the entries are arranged alphabetically; an alphabetical encyclopedia.
To look up in a dictionary.

free.def: To make free; set at liberty; release.

encyclopedia.def: Similarly comprehensive works in other formats.

cat.def: To hoist (an anchor) by its ring so that it hangs at the cathead.

gratis.def: In a free way: without charge.

word.def: The smallest unit of language that has a particular meaning and can be expressed by itself; the smallest discrete, meaningful unit of language. (contrast morpheme.)
To say or write (something) using particular words; to phrase (something).

book.def: A collection of sheets of paper bound together to hinge at one edge, containing printed or written material, pictures, etc.

pound.def: A unit of weight in various measurement systems.

pond.def: An inland body of standing water, either natural or man-made, that is smaller than a lake.
To block the flow of water so that it can escape only through evaporation or seepage; to dam.

nonsense.def: Letters or words, in writing or speech, that have no meaning or pattern or seem to have no meaning.

pie.def: A type of pastry that consists of an outer crust and a filling. (Savory pies are more popular in the UK and sweet pies are more popular in the US, so "pie" without qualification has different connotations in these dialects.)
To hit in the face with a pie, either for comic effect or as a means of protest (see also pieing).

crow.def: A bird, usually black, of the genus Corvus, having a strong conical beak, with projecting bristles; it has a harsh, croaking call.
Dark black, the color of a crow; crow-black.
To make the shrill sound characteristic of a rooster; to make a sound in this manner, either in gaiety, joy, pleasure, or defiance.

raven.def: Any of several, generally large, species of birds in the genus Corvus with lustrous black plumage; especially the common raven (Corvus corax).
Especially of hair: of the jet-black and often glossy colour of the plumage of a raven (etymology 1, noun sense 1).

elephant.def: A large mammal of the family Elephantidae in the order Proboscidea, having a trunk, and native to Africa and Asia.

brown.def: A colour like that of chocolate or coffee.

month.def: A period into which a year is divided, historically based on the phases of the moon.

march.def: A formal, rhythmic way of walking, used especially by soldiers, by bands, and in ceremonies.
To walk with long, regular strides, as a soldier does.

may.def: To be strong; to have power (over).
The hawthorn bush or its blossoms.

october.def: A type of ale traditionally brewed in October.
In the early Soviet Union, to give a child a name tinged with Soviet revolutionary thought, as opposed to religious christening.

day.def: The time when the Sun is above the horizon and it lights the sky.
To spend a day (in a place).

monday.def: The second day of the week in many religious traditions, and the first day of the week in systems using the ISO 8601 norm. It follows Sunday and precedes Tuesday.

tuesday.def: The third day of the week in many religious traditions, and the second day of the week in systems that use the ISO 8601 norm; it follows Monday and precedes Wednesday.

wednesday.def: The fourth day of the week in many religious traditions, and the third day of the week in systems using the ISO 8601 norm; it follows Tuesday and precedes Thursday.

thursday.def: The fifth day of the week in many religious traditions, and the fourth day of the week in systems using the ISO 8601 norm; it follows Wednesday and precedes Friday.

friday.def: The sixth day of the week in many religious traditions, and the fifth day of the week in systems using the ISO 8601 norm; the Muslim Sabbath; it follows Thursday and precedes Saturday.

saturday.def: The seventh day of the week in many religious traditions, and the sixth day of the week in systems using the ISO 8601 norm; the Jewish Sabbath; it follows Friday and precedes Sunday.
To spend Saturday (at a place or doing an activity).

sunday.def: The first day of the week in many religious traditions, and the seventh day of the week in systems using the ISO 8601 standard; the Christian Sabbath; the Lord's Day; it follows Saturday and precedes Monday.
To spend Sunday (at a certain place, with a certain person or people, etc.).

dialect.def: A variety of a language that is characteristic of a particular area, community, or social group, differing from other varieties of the same language in relatively minor ways as regards grammar, phonology, and lexicon.

semantics.def: A branch of linguistics studying the meaning of words.

noun.def: A word that functions as the name of a specific object or set of objects, such as person, animal, place, word, thing, phenomenon, substance, quality, or idea: one of the basic parts of speech in many languages, including English.
To convert a word to a noun.

hour.def: A unit of time of one twenty-fourth of a day (sixty minutes).

alphabetical.def: Pertaining to, furnished with, or expressed by letters of the alphabet.

minute.def: A unit of time which is one sixtieth of an hour (sixty seconds).
Of an event, to write in a memo or the minutes of a meeting.

barter.def: An exchange of goods or services without the use of money.
To exchange goods or services without involving money.

swap.def: To exchange or give (something) in an non-normal exchange (for something else).
An exchange of two comparable things.

trade.def: The buying and selling of goods and services on a market.
Of a product, produced for sale in the ordinary bulk retail trade and hence of only the most basic quality.

verb.def: A word that indicates an action, event, or state of being.
To use any word that is or was not a verb (especially a noun) as if it were a verb.

adjective.def: A word that modifies a noun or noun phrase or describes a noun’s referent.
Adjectival; pertaining to or functioning as an adjective.
To make an adjective of; to form or convert into an adjective.

craft.def: To make by hand and with much skill.

patronage.def: The act of providing approval and support; backing; championship.
To support by being a patron of.

deal.def: A division, a portion, a share, a part, a piece.
To distribute among a number of recipients, to give out as one’s portion or share.

merchandise.def: Goods which are or were offered or intended for sale.
To engage in trade; to carry on commerce.

wares.def: Goods or services that are for sale.

product.def: Anything that is produced; a result.

eagle.def: Any of several large carnivorous and carrion-eating birds in the family Accipitridae, having a powerful hooked bill and keen vision.

head.def: The part of the body of an animal or human which contains the brain, mouth, and main sense organs.
Of, relating to, or intended for the head.
To be in command of. (See also head up.)

pumpkin.def: A domesticated plant, in species Cucurbita pepo, similar in growth pattern, foliage, flower, and fruit to the squash or melon.

name.def: Any nounal word or phrase which indicates a particular person, place, class, or thing.

fabian.def: Pertaining to or reminiscent of Roman general Fabius Maximus, whose tactics against Hannibal during the Second Punic War famously consisted of delaying or avoiding combat, focusing instead on weakening the enemy by cutting off supply lines.
A Fabian socialist, a gradualist socialist; a member of the Fabian Society.

fable.def: A fictitious narrative intended to enforce some useful truth or precept, usually with animals, etc. as characters; an apologue. Prototypically, Aesop's Fables.
To compose fables; hence, to write or speak fiction; to write or utter what is not true.

aardvark.def: The nocturnal, insectivorous, burrowing mammal Orycteropus afer, of the order Tubulidentata and somewhat resembling a pig. Common in some parts of sub-Saharan Africa.

aback.def: Towards the back or rear; backwards.

abacus.def: A table or tray scattered with sand which was used for calculating or drawing.

abalone.def: An edible univalve mollusc of the genus Haliotis, having a shell lined with mother-of-pearl.

abandon.def: To give up or relinquish control of, to surrender or to give oneself over, or to yield to one's emotions.
A yielding to natural impulses or inhibitions; freedom from artificial constraint, with loss of appreciation of consequences. (Now especially in the phrase with abandon.)

abandoned.def: Having given oneself up to vice; immoral; extremely wicked, or sinning without restraint; irreclaimably wicked.

abandonment.def: The act of abandoning, or the state of being abandoned; total desertion; relinquishment.

abate.def: To lessen (something) in force or intensity; to moderate.
Abatement; reduction; (countable) an instance of this.

abattoir.def: A public slaughterhouse for cattle, sheep, etc.

abba.def: Father; religious superior; in the Syriac, Coptic, and Ethiopic churches, a title given to the bishops, and by the bishops to the patriarch; a title given to Jewish scholars in the Talmudic period.

abbess.def: A female superior or governess of a nunnery, or convent of nuns, having the same authority over the nuns which the abbots have over the monks.

abbey.def: The office or dominion of an abbot or abbess.

abbot.def: The superior or head of an abbey or monastery.

abbreviation.def: The result of shortening or reducing; abridgment.

abdicate.def: To disclaim and expel from the family, as a father his child; to disown; to disinherit.

abdominal.def: Of or pertaining to the abdomen; ventral.
A fish of the order Abdominales.

abduct.def: To take away by force; to carry away (a human being) wrongfully and usually with violence or deception; to kidnap.

abed.def: In bed, or on the bed; confined to bed.

aberrant.def: A person or object that deviates from the rest of a group.

aberration.def: The act of wandering; deviation from truth, moral rectitude; abnormal; divergence from the straight, correct, proper, normal, or from the natural state.

abhor.def: To regard (someone or something) as horrifying or detestable; to feel great repugnance toward.

abhorrent.def: Inconsistent with, or far removed from, something; strongly opposed.

abide.def: To endure without yielding; to withstand.

abiding.def: Continuing or persisting in the same state: lasting, enduring; steadfast.
The action of one who abides; the state of an abider.

abject.def: Existing in or sunk to a low condition, position, or state; contemptible, despicable, miserable.
A person in the lowest and most despicable condition; an oppressed person; an outcast; also, such people as a class.
To cast off or out (someone or something); to reject, especially as contemptible or inferior.

ablaze.def: Burning fiercely; in a blaze; on fire.

able.def: Having the necessary powers or the needed resources to accomplish a task.
The letter "A" in Navy Phonetic Alphabet.

abnormal.def: Not conforming to rule or system; deviating from the usual or normal type.
A person or object that is not normal.

abnormality.def: The state or quality of being abnormal; variation; irregularity.

abnormally.def: In an abnormal manner; in a way that deviates from a standard, norm, or average.

aboard.def: On board; into or within a ship or boat; hence, into or within a railway car.

abode.def: To bode; to foreshow; to presage.

abolish.def: To end a law, system, institution, custom or practice.

abolition.def: The act of abolishing; an annulling; abrogation.

abominable.def: Worthy of, or causing, abhorrence, as a thing of evil omen; odious in the utmost degree; very hateful; detestable; loathsome; execrable.

abomination.def: An abominable act; a disgusting vice; a despicable habit.

aboriginal.def: First according to historical or scientific records; original; indigenous; primitive.
An animal or plant native to a region.

abort.def: An early termination of a mission, action, or procedure in relation to missiles or spacecraft; the craft making such a mission.
To miscarry; to bring forth (non-living) offspring prematurely.

aborted.def: Stopped before completion; especially because of problems or danger.

abortion.def: The expulsion from the womb of a foetus or embryo before it is fully developed, with loss of the foetus.

abound.def: To be full to overflowing; to bristle.

about.def: On all sides, or in every or any direction from a point; around.
Moving around or in motion; astir.
To change the course of (a ship) to the other tack; to bring (a ship) about.

above.def: Directly overhead; vertically on top of.

abracadabra.def: A use of the mystical term ‘abracadabra’, supposed to work as part of a healing charm or a magical spell; any spell or incantation making use of the word.

abrasion.def: The act of abrading, wearing, or rubbing off; the wearing away by friction.

abrasive.def: Producing abrasion; rough enough to wear away the outer surface.
A hard inorganic substance or material consisting in powder or granule form such as sandpaper, pumice, or emery, used for cleaning, smoothing, or polishing.

abreast.def: Side by side and facing forward.

abroad.def: Beyond the bounds of a country; in foreign countries.

abrupt.def: Something which is abrupt; an abyss.

abruptly.def: In an abrupt manner; without giving notice, or without the usual forms; suddenly; precipitously.

abscess.def: A cavity caused by tissue destruction, usually because of infection, filled with pus and surrounded by inflamed tissue.
To form a pus-filled cavity, typically from an infection.

kun.def: In the Japanese language, the pronunciation, or reading, of a kanji character as a native Japanese word that means what the character represents, contrasted with on.

odd.def: Differing from what is usual, ordinary or expected.
Something left over, not forming part of a set.

quiz.def: An odd, puzzling or absurd person or thing.
To hoax; to chaff or mock with pretended seriousness of discourse; to make sport of, as by obscure questions.

calendar.def: Any system by which time is divided into days, weeks, months, and years.
To set a date for a proceeding in court, usually done by a judge at a calendar call.

millennium.def: A period of time consisting of one thousand years.

week.def: Any period of seven consecutive days.

leap.def: The act of leaping or jumping.

winter.def: The period of decay, old age, death, or the like.
To spend the winter (in a particular place).

bone.def: A composite material consisting largely of calcium phosphate and collagen and making up the skeleton of most vertebrates.
Of an off-white colour, like the colour of bone.
To prepare (meat, etc) by removing the bone or bones from.

servant.def: One who is hired to perform regular household or other duties, and receives compensation. As opposed to a slave.

robot.def: A system of serfdom used in Central Europe, under which a tenant's rent was paid in forced labour.

english.def: The people of England, e.g., Englishmen and Englishwomen.
To translate, adapt or render into English.

today.def: On the current day or date.

the.def: With a comparative or with more and a verb phrase, establishes a correlation with one or more other such comparatives.

absent.def: Being away from a place; withdrawn from a place; existing but not present; (sometimes) missing.
Something absent, especially absent people collectively; those who were or are not there.

absentee.def: A person who is absent from his or her employment, school, post, duty, etc.

absolutely.def: In an absolute or unconditional manner; utterly, positively, wholly.

absolution.def: An absolving of sins from ecclesiastical penalties by an authority.

absolve.def: To set free, release or discharge (from obligations, debts, responsibility etc.).

absurdity.def: That which is absurd; an absurd action; a logical contradiction.

abundantly.def: In an abundant manner; in a sufficient degree; in large measure.

abuser.def: One who abuses someone or something.

abusive.def: Prone to treat someone badly by coarse, insulting words or other maltreatment; vituperative; reproachful; scurrilous.

abut.def: To touch by means of a mutual border, edge or end; to border on; to lie adjacent (to); to be contiguous (said of an area of land)

abysmal.def: Pertaining to, or resembling an abyss.

academically.def: In an academic style or way; from an academic perspective.

accept.def: To receive, especially with a consent, with favour, or with approval.

acceptable.def: Worthy, decent, sure of being accepted or received with at least moderate pleasure.
Someone or something that is acceptable.

acceptance.def: The act of accepting; the receiving of something offered, with acquiescence, approbation, or satisfaction; especially, favourable reception; approval.

accidental.def: Pertaining to accident and not essence; thus, inessential; incidental; secondary.
A property which is not essential; a nonessential; anything happening accidentally.

accidentally.def: In an accidental manner; by chance, unexpectedly.

accommodating.def: Affording, or disposed to afford, accommodation; obliging; helpful.

according.def: Agreeing; in agreement or harmony; harmonious.

accordion.def: A box-shaped musical instrument played by compressing or expanding its bellows while pressing its buttons or its keys, causing pallets to open, which allow air to flow across strips of brass or steel (reeds).
To fold up, in the manner of an accordion

accurate.def: Telling the truth or giving a true result; exact; not defective or faulty.

accurately.def: In an accurate manner; exactly; precisely; without error or defect.

plural.def: Consisting of or containing more than one of something.
The plural number. In English, referring to more or less than one of something.

homeworld.def: The world on which someone or something originated; a home planet or moon.

avatar.def: An incarnation of a deity, particularly Vishnu.

alien.def: A person, animal, plant, or other thing which is from outside the family, group, organization, or territory under consideration.
Not belonging to the same country, land, or government, or to the citizens or subjects thereof; foreign.

definition.def: A statement of the meaning of a word, word group, sign, or symbol; especially, a dictionary definition.

season.def: Each of the divisions of a year based on the prevailing weather: spring, summer, autumn (fall) and winter; or the rainy (monsoon) and dry season, depending on the climate.
To habituate, accustom, or inure (someone or something) to a particular use, purpose, or circumstance.

autumn.def: The time period when someone or something is past its prime.
To spend the autumn (in a particular place).

summer.def: year; used to give the age of a person, usually a young one.
To spend the summer, as in a particular place on holiday.

spring.def: An act of springing: a leap, a jump.

libre.def: Especially of the will: free, independent, unconstrained.
A free (not enslaved) black person in a French- or Spanish-colonized area, especially New Orleans.

color.def: The spectral composition of visible light.
Conveying color, as opposed to shades of gray.

van.def: An enclosed railway vehicle for transport of goods, such as a boxcar/box van.
To transport in a van or similar vehicle (especially of horses).

dat.def: Digital Audio Tape, a digital data storage tape format using a dual-spooled cartridge and magnetic tape, used for digital audio and data storage.

die.def: To stop living; to become dead; to undergo death.
The cubical part of a pedestal; a plinth.

google.def: To bowl (a cricket ball) so that it performs a googly (“a ball by a leg-break bowler that spins from off to leg (to a right-handed batsman), unlike a normal leg-break delivery”).
An Internet search, such as one performed on the Google search engine.

lens.def: An object, usually made of glass, that focuses or defocuses the light that passes through it.

whatever.def: A thing or person whose actual name is unknown or forgotten.
At all; in any way; whatsoever.

transvestite.def: A person who sometimes wears clothes traditionally worn by and associated with the opposite sex; typically a male who cross-dresses occasionally by habit or personal choice.

debt.def: An action, state of mind, or object one has an obligation to perform for another, adopt toward another, or give to another.

orange.def: An evergreen tree of the genus Citrus such as Citrus sinensis which yields oranges (the fruit).
Having the colour of the fruit of an orange tree; yellowred; reddish-yellow.

polish.def: Of, from or native to Poland, or relating to the Polish language.
To shine; to make a surface very smooth or shiny by rubbing, cleaning, or grinding.

seven.def: The digit/figure 7 or an occurrence thereof.

premature.def: Occurring before a state of readiness or maturity has arrived.

birth.def: The process of childbearing; the beginning of life; the emergence of a human baby or other viviparous animal offspring from the mother's body into the environment.
A familial relationship established by childbirth.
To bear or give birth to (a child).

accord.def: Agreement or concurrence of opinion, will, or action.
To make to agree or correspond; to suit one thing to another; to adjust.

wolf.def: Canis lupus; the largest wild member of the canine subfamily.
To devour; to gobble; to eat (something) voraciously.

planet.def: Each of the seven major bodies which move relative to the fixed stars in the night sky—the Moon, Mercury, Venus, the Sun, Mars, Jupiter and Saturn.

star.def: Any small, natural and bright dot in the sky, most visible in the night or twilight sky. This sense includes the planets, but it is now sometimes used in exclusion of them due to influence from the technical astronomical sense.
To appear as a featured performer or headliner, especially in an entertainment program.

sky.def: The atmosphere above a given point, especially as visible from the surface of the Earth as the place where the sun, moon, stars, and clouds are seen.
To drink (a beverage) from a container without one's lips touching the container.

can.def: A container or vessel, especially for liquids, usually made of metal.

zero.def: The numeric symbol that represents the cardinal number zero.
Of a cloud ceiling, limiting vision to 50 feet (15 meters) or less.
To set some amount to be zero.

number.def: To total or count; to amount to.

oxymoron.def: A figure of speech in which two words or phrases with opposing meanings are used together intentionally for effect.

bureaucrat.def: An official who is part of a bureaucracy.

alphabet.def: The set of letters used when writing in a language.
To designate by the letters of the alphabet; to arrange alphabetically.

achievement.def: The act of achieving or performing; a successful performance; accomplishment.

acid.def: Sour, sharp, or biting to the taste; tart; having the taste of vinegar.

teleport.def: To travel, often instantaneously, from one point to another without physically crossing the distance between the two points.

growth.def: An increase in size, number, value, or strength.

quarter.def: Pertaining to an aspect of a quarter.
To divide into quarters; to divide by four.

parole.def: Originally, one's oath or word of honour, given as a condition of release from custody; now specifically, describing the release of a former prisoner under certain conditions, especially the promise of good behaviour.
To release (a prisoner) on the understanding that s/he checks in regularly and obeys the law.

german.def: A native or inhabitant of Germany; a person of German citizenship or nationality.
Of or relating to the nation of Germany.

decade.def: A group, set, or series of ten , particularly

grass.def: Any plant of the family Poaceae, characterized by leaves that arise from nodes in the stem and leaf bases that wrap around the stem, especially those grown as ground cover rather than for grain.
To lay out on the grass; to knock down (an opponent etc.).

one.def: Of a period of time, being particular.
To cause to become one; to gather into a single whole; to unite.

four.def: The digit or figure 4; an occurrence thereof.

ymca.def: A hostel or other facility operated by the Young Men's Christian Association.

crude.def: Any substance in its natural state.

letter.def: To print, inscribe, or paint letters on something.

medicine.def: A substance which specifically promotes healing when ingested or consumed in some way; a pharmaceutical drug.

year.def: A period of time akin to the time taken for the Earth to undergo a full cycle of seasons.

decrypt.def: To convert (an encrypted or coded message) back into plain text.

irish.def: A board game of the tables family.
Pertaining to or originating from Ireland or the Irish people.

second.def: Number-two; following after the first one with nothing between them. The ordinal number corresponding to the cardinal number two.
After the first; at the second rank.
Something that is number two in a series.

century.def: A political division of ancient Rome, meeting in the Centuriate Assembly.

clock.def: A chronometer, an instrument that measures time, particularly the time of day.

millisecond.def: An SI unit of time equal to 10⁻³ seconds. Symbol: ms

meat.def: The flesh (muscle tissue) of an animal used as food, or a food designed to replicate its taste and texture (like plant-based meat).

beer.def: An alcoholic drink fermented from starch material, commonly barley malt; often with hops or some other substance (like gruit) to impart a bitter flavor.

mann.def: A fairy chess piece that can move to any adjacent square. It moves like a king but is not a royal piece.

pseudo.def: An intellectually pretentious person; a pseudointellectual.
Other than what is apparent; spurious; sham.

umbrella.def: A cloth-covered frame used for protection against rain or sun.
To cover or protect, as if by an umbrella.

chairman.def: A person presiding over a meeting.

bit.def: A piece of metal placed in a horse's mouth and connected to the reins to direct the animal.
To put a bridle upon; to put the bit in the mouth of (a horse).

point.def: To extend the index finger in the direction of something in order to show where it is or to draw attention to it.

sun.def: A star, especially when seen as the centre of any single solar system.
To expose to the heat and radiation of the sun.

man.def: Synonym of manly. (Only used in man enough.)
To supply (something) with staff or crew (of either sex).

are.def: An accepted (but deprecated and rarely used) metric unit of area equal to 100 square metres, or a former unit of approximately the same extent. Symbol: a.

metric.def: Of or relating to the metric system of measurement.
A measure for something; a means of deriving a quantitative measurement or approximation for otherwise qualitative phenomena (especially used in engineering).
To measure or analyse statistical data concerning the quality or effectiveness of a process.

quality.def: (attributive) Being of good worth, well made, fit for purpose; of high quality.

nigger.def: A black person; a person of black African descent.
To clear land by laying light pieces of round timber across the trunks of the trees and setting fire to them at the point of contact, by which means the trees are slowly burned through.

cunt.def: The female genitalia, especially the vulva.

dick.def: To mistreat or take advantage of somebody (often with around or up).

motherfucker.def: An extremely contemptible, vicious or mean person.

biblical.def: Of or relating to the Bible.

fart.def: To emit digestive gases from the anus; to flatulate.
An emission of digestive gases from the anus; a flatus.

rape.def: An experience that is pleasant for one party and unpleasant for the other, particularly when the unwilling partner's suffering is worse than necessary.
To force sexual intercourse or other sexual activity upon (someone) without their consent.

cum.def: To have an orgasm, to feel the sensation of an orgasm.

amoral.def: Done without consideration for morality or immorality.

doctrine.def: A belief or tenet, especially about philosophical or theological matters.

port.def: A place on the coast at which ships can shelter, or dock to load and unload cargo or passengers.
Of or relating to port, the left-hand side of a vessel when facing the bow.
To turn or put to the left or larboard side of a ship; said of the helm.

cod.def: Any of various types of sea fish or the meat from said fish.
Having the character of imitation; jocular.
To attempt to deceive or confuse; to kid.

six.def: A group or set with six elements.

edward.def: A gold coin produced in the reign of King Edward.

jiffy.def: A very short, unspecified length of time.

date.def: The fruit of the date palm, Phoenix dactylifera, somewhat in the shape of an olive, containing a soft, sweet pulp and enclosing a hard kernel.
To note the time or place of writing or executing; to express in an instrument the time of its execution.

language.def: A body of words, and set of methods of combining them (called a grammar), understood by a community and used as a form of communication.
To communicate by language; to express in language.

bot.def: The larva of a botfly, which infests the skin of various mammals, producing warbles, or the nasal passage of sheep, or the stomach of horses.

flute.def: A recorder, also a woodwind instrument.

railway.def: A transport system using rails used to move passengers or goods.

peso.def: A former unit of currency in Spain and Spain's colonies, worth 8 reales; the Spanish dollar.

trillion.def: A statistic formed by a player playing some number of minutes, but recording no stats.

ten.def: A set or group with ten elements.

singular.def: Being only one of a larger population; single, individual.
A form of a word that refers to only one person or thing.

reality.def: The state of being actual or real; realness.

tao.def: The art or skill of doing something in harmony with the essential nature of the thing.

musician.def: A composer, conductor, or performer of music; specifically, a person who sings and/or plays a musical instrument as a hobby, occupation, or profession.

weapon.def: An instrument of attack or defense in combat or hunting, e.g. most guns, missiles, or swords.
To equip with a weapon; to arm.

stock.def: To have on hand for sale.
Of a type normally available for purchase/in stock.

aria.def: A musical piece written typically for a solo voice with orchestral accompaniment in an opera or cantata.

hell.def: A place or situation of great suffering in life.
To make hellish; to place (someone) in hell; to make (a place) into a hell.

conceal.def: To hide something from view or from public knowledge, to try to keep something secret.

dutch.def: Of or pertaining to the Netherlands, the Dutch people or the Dutch language.
The people of the Netherlands, or one of certain ethnic groups descending from the people of the Netherlands.
To treat cocoa beans or powder with an alkali solution to darken the color and lessen the bitterness of the flavor.

acronym.def: An abbreviation formed by the initial letters of other words.

music.def: A series of sounds organized in time, usually employing some combination of harmony, melody, rhythm, tempo, etc., often to convey a mood.
To seduce or entice with music.

A low-pitched, resonant sound, such as of an explosion.

earth.def: To connect electrically to the earth.

snake.def: Any of the suborder Serpentes of legless reptile with long, thin bodies and fork-shaped tongues.
To follow or move in a winding route.

thick.def: Relatively great in extent from one surface to the opposite in its smallest solid dimension.
The thickest, or most active or intense, part of something.

northeast.def: The intercardinal compass point halfway between north and east; specifically at a bearing of 45°.
Of, in or pertaining to the northeast; northeastern.
Towards the direction of the northeast; northeastwards.

northwest.def: The intercardinal compass point halfway between west and north; specifically at a bearing of 315°.
Of, in or pertaining to the northwest; northwestern.
Towards or in the direction of the northwest; northwestwards.

southwest.def: The intercardinal compass point halfway between south and west; specifically at a bearing of 225°.
Of, in or pertaining to the southwest; southwestern.
Towards or in the direction of the southwest; southwestwards.

southeast.def: The intercardinal compass point halfway between east and south; specifically at a bearing of 135°.
Of, in or pertaining to the southeast; southeastern.
Towards or in the direction of the southeast; southeastwards.

was.def: Used in phrases with existential there when the semantic subject is (usually third-person) plural.

wax.def: To coat with wax or a similar material.

beeswax.def: A wax secreted by bees from which they make honeycomb; or, the processed form of this wax used in the manufacture of various goods.

what.def: In what way; to what extent.

left.def: Designating the side of the body toward the west when one is facing north; the side of the body on which the heart is located in most humans; the opposite of right. This arrow points to the reader's left: ←

right.def: Designating the side of the body which is positioned to the east if one is facing north, the side on which the heart is not located in most humans. This arrow points to the reader's right: →
That which complies with justice, law or reason.

parent.def: A person who raises a child (which they have made, adopted, fostered, taken as their own, etc.).
To act as parent, to raise or rear.

father.def: A male parent, especially of a human; a male who parents a child (which he has sired, adopted, fostered, taken as his own, etc.).
To be a father to; to sire.

mother.def: A female parent, especially of a human; a female who parents a child (which she has given birth to, adopted, or fostered).
To give birth to or produce (as its female parent) a child. (Compare father.)

sibling.def: A person who shares a parent; one's brother or sister who one shares a parent with.

brother.def: Son of the same parents as another person.

sister.def: A daughter of the same parents as another person; a female sibling.
To strengthen (a supporting beam) by fastening a second beam alongside it.

child.def: A person who has not yet reached adulthood, whether natural (puberty), cultural (initiation), or legal (majority).
To give birth; to beget or procreate.

son.def: To produce (i.e. bear, father, beget) a son.

grandfather.def: To be, or act as, a grandfather to.

uncle.def: The brother or brother-in-law of one’s parent.
To address somebody by the term uncle.

aunt.def: The sister or sister-in-law of one’s parent.

nephew.def: A son of one's sibling, brother-in-law, or sister-in-law; either a son of one's brother (fraternal nephew) or a son of one's sister (sororal nephew).

niece.def: A daughter of one’s sibling, brother-in-law, or sister-in-law; either the daughter of one's brother ("fraternal niece"), or of one's sister ("sororal niece").

cousin.def: Chiefly with a qualifying word: Any relation (especially a distant one) who is not a direct ancestor or descendant but part of a person's extended family; a kinsman or kinswoman.

bee.def: A flying insect, of the clade Anthophila within the hymenopteran superfamily Apoidea, known for its organised societies (though only a minority have them), for collecting pollen and (in some species) producing wax and honey.

honey.def: A sweet, viscous, gold-colored fluid produced from plant nectar by bees, and often consumed by humans.

bathroom.def: A room containing a shower or bathtub, and (typically but not necessarily) a toilet.
To assist a patient with using the toilet and general personal hygiene.

car.def: A wheeled vehicle that moves independently, with at least three wheels, powered mechanically, steered by a driver and mostly for personal transportation but relatively smaller than a truck/lorry and a bus.

wing.def: An appendage of an animal's (bird, bat, insect) body that enables it to fly.
To injure slightly (as with a gunshot), especially in the wing or arm.

hot.def: Relating to heat and conditions which produce it.
To heat; to make or become hot.

warm.def: Of a somewhat high temperature, often but not always connoting that the high temperature is pleasant rather than uncomfortable.
The act of warming, or the state of being warmed; a heating.

temperature.def: A measure of cold or heat, often measurable with a thermometer.

fresh.def: A rush of water, along a river or onto the land; a flood.

expression.def: The action of expressing thoughts, ideas, feelings, etc.

cool.def: A moderate or refreshing state of cold; moderate temperature of the air between hot and cold; coolness.
To lose heat, to get colder.

thai.def: A person living in or coming from Thailand.

quadruple.def: Being four times as long, as big or as many of something.
Something that is four times the usual number, amount, size, etc.

quagmire.def: A swampy, soggy area of ground.
To embroil (a person, etc.) in complexity or difficulty.

rainbow.def: A multicoloured arch in the sky, produced by prismatic refraction of light within droplets of rain in the air.
Multicolored, especially if in rainbow order.
To brighten with, or as with, a rainbow; to pattern with the colours of the rainbow.

xerox.def: To make a copy using a xerographer.

pimple.def: An inflamed (raised and colored) spot on the surface of the skin that is usually painful and fills with pus.

iceberg.def: The seaward end of a glacier.

other.def: An other, another (person, etc), more often rendered as another.

not.def: Negates the meaning of the modified verb.
An instance of using the word “not”; a negation or denial.

that.def: To a given extent or degree.
Something being indicated that is there; one of those.

finger.def: A slender jointed extremity of the human hand, (often) exclusive of the thumb.
To identify or point out; to blame for something.

flower.def: A colorful, conspicuous structure associated with angiosperms, frequently scented and attracting various insects, and which may or may not be used for sexual reproduction.

good.def: Of a person or an animal:
The forces or behaviours that are the enemy of evil. Usually consists of helping others and general benevolence.

male.def: Belonging to the sex which typically produces sperm, or to the gender which is typically associated with it.
One of the male (masculine) sex or gender.

female.def: Belonging to the sex which typically produces eggs (ova), or to the gender which is typically associated with it.
One of the female (feminine) sex or gender.

thumb.def: The shortest and thickest digit of the hand that for humans has the most mobility and can be made to oppose (moved to touch) all of the other fingers.
To touch or cover with the thumb.

forefinger.def: The index finger: the first finger next to the thumb.

pinky.def: Methylated spirits mixed with red wine or Condy's crystals.

norwegian.def: Of or pertaining to Norway (the country).

duck.def: To quickly lower (the head or body), often in order to prevent it from being struck by something.
A cave passage containing water with low, or no, airspace.

rue.def: To repent of or regret (some past action or event); to wish that a past action or event had not taken place.

apology.def: An expression of remorse or regret for having said or done something that harmed another: an instance of apologizing (saying that one is sorry).

tulip.def: A type of flowering plant, genus Tulipa.

habit.def: An action performed on a regular basis.

habitable.def: Safe and comfortable, where humans, or other animals, can live; fit for habitation.

habitat.def: Conditions suitable for an organism or population of organisms to live.

habitual.def: Of or relating to a habit; established as a habit; performed over and over again; recurrent, recurring.
One who does something habitually, such as a serial criminal offender.

hacienda.def: A large homestead in a ranch or estate, usually in places where Colonial Spanish culture has had architectural influence.

hack.def: To chop or cut down in a rough manner.

mine.def: An excavation from which ore or solid minerals are taken, especially one consisting of underground tunnels.
To remove (rock or ore) from the ground.

very.def: To a great extent or degree.

kingdom.def: A realm having a king or queen as its actual or nominal sovereign.

jump.def: To propel oneself rapidly upward, downward and/or in any horizontal direction such that momentum causes the body to become airborne.
The act of jumping; a leap; a spring; a bound.

hole.def: A hollow place or cavity; an excavation; a pit; a dent; a depression; a fissure.
To make holes in (an object or surface).

wood.def: The substance making up the central part of the trunk and branches of a tree. Used as a material for construction, to manufacture various items, etc. or as fuel.
To cover or plant with trees.

former.def: Someone who forms something; a maker; a creator or founder.

anterior.def: Nearer the forward end, especially in the front of the body; nearer the head or forepart of an animal.

astronaut.def: A member of the crew of a spaceship or other spacecraft that travels beyond Earth's atmosphere, or someone trained to serve that purpose.

crew.def: To be a member of a vessel's crew

remote.def: To connect to a computer from a remote location.

complete.def: To finish; to make done; to reach the end.
With all parts included; with nothing missing; full.

project.def: A planned endeavor, usually with a specific goal and accomplished in several steps or stages.

visit.def: To habitually go to (someone in distress, sickness etc.) to comfort them. (Now generally merged into later senses, below.)

experiment.def: A test under controlled conditions made to either demonstrate a known truth, examine the validity of a hypothesis, or determine the efficacy or likelihood of something previously untried.

learn.def: To acquire, or attempt to acquire knowledge or an ability to do something.

bold.def: To make (a font or some text) bold.

how.def: The means by which something is accomplished.

crimson.def: To become crimson or deep red; to blush.

bisque.def: A thick creamy soup made from fish, shellfish, meat or vegetables.
Of a pale pinkish brown colour.
To prepare ceramics in the bisque style.

azure.def: The clear blue colour of the sky; also, a pigment or dye of this colour.
Sky blue; resembling the clear blue colour of the unclouded sky.

chartreuse.def: A yellow or green liqueur made by Carthusian monks.

collateral.def: Parallel, in the same vein, side by side.
A security or guarantee (usually an asset) pledged for the repayment of a loan if one cannot procure enough funds to repay.

annuity.def: A right to receive amounts of money regularly over a certain fixed period, in perpetuity, or, especially, over the remaining life or lives of one or more beneficiaries.

annually.def: Once every year without fail, yearly

monthly.def: A publication that is published once a month.

weekly.def: Of or relating to a week.
A publication that is published once a week.

quarterly.def: Occurring once every quarter year (three months); taking place quarter-yearly.
A periodical publication that appears four times per year.

mortgage.def: A legal agreement in which a borrower pledges real property as collateral for a loan used to purchase or refinance that property.

To borrow against a property, to obtain a loan for another purpose by giving away the right of seizure to the lender over a fixed property such as a house or piece of land; to pledge a property in order to get a loan.

chocolate.def: A food made from ground roasted cocoa beans.
To add chocolate to; to cover (food) in chocolate.

cream.def: The butterfat or milkfat part of milk which rises to the top; this part when separated from the remainder.
Cream-coloured; having a yellowish white colour.
To puree, to blend with a liquifying process.

bombard.def: A medieval primitive cannon, used chiefly in sieges for throwing heavy stone balls.
To continuously attack something with bombs, artillery shells or other missiles or projectiles.

pigment.def: Any color in plant or animal cells.
To add color or pigment to something.

dye.def: A colorant, especially one that has an affinity to the substrate to which it is applied.
To colour with dye, or as if with dye.

finale.def: The grand end of something, especially of a show or piece of music.

maul.def: A heavy long-handled hammer, used for splitting logs by driving a wedge into them, or in combat.
To handle someone or something in a rough way.

kerosene.def: A thin, often colorless or blue or straw-colored petroleum-based fuel, heavier than gasoline/petrol or naphtha but lighter than diesel, used primarily as jet fuel but also for heating and lighting in some remote or impoverished areas.

candidate.def: A person who seeks to be elected or appointed to a position or privilege.
To stand as a candidate for an office, typically for a religious one.

gossip.def: Someone who likes to talk about other people's private or personal business.
To talk about someone else's private or personal business, especially in a manner that spreads the information.

martyr.def: One who willingly accepts being put to death or willingly accepts challenging and exposing iniquity done to oneself for adhering openly to one's religious beliefs; notably, saints canonized after red martyrdom.
To make someone into a martyr by putting them to death for adhering to, or acting in accordance with, some belief, especially religious; to sacrifice on account of faith or profession.

fuchsia.def: A popular garden plant, of the genus Fuchsia, of the Onagraceae family, shrubs with red, pink or purple flowers.

available.def: Such as one may avail oneself of; capable of being used for the accomplishment of a purpose.

update.def: An additional piece of information, an addition to existing information.
To bring (a thing) up to date.

handcuffs.def: A fastening consisting of two metal rings, designed to go around a person's wrists, and connected by a chain or hinge.

rat.def: Any of the numerous members of several rodent families that usually have short limbs, a pointy snout, a long, hairless tail, and a body length greater than about 12 cm, or 5 inches.

gray.def: Of a color between black and white, having neutral hue and intermediate brightness.
An achromatic colour between black and white.

atmosphere.def: The gases surrounding the Earth or any astronomical body.

ivory.def: The hard white form of dentin which forms the tusks of elephants, walruses and other animals.

navy.def: A country's entire maritime military force, including ships and personnel.
Having the dark blue colour of navy blue.

maroon.def: An escaped black slave of the Caribbean and the Americas or a descendant of such a person.
Associated with Maroon culture, communities or peoples.
To abandon in a remote, desolate place, as on a desert island.

room.def: An opportunity or scope (to do something).
To reside, especially as a boarder or tenant.

tan.def: To change to a tan colour due to exposure to the sun.

lob.def: To throw or hit a ball into the air in a high arc.
A pass or stroke which arcs high into the air.

sombrero.def: A kind of hat with a high conical or cylindrical crown and a saucer-shaped brim, highly embroidered, made of plush felt.

khaki.def: A dull, yellowish-brown colour, the colour of dust.
Dust-coloured; of the colour of dust.

sorbet.def: Frozen fruit juice, sometimes mixed with egg whites, eaten as dessert or between courses of a meal.

tamale.def: A Mexican dish of cornmeal dough shell filled with various ingredients (e.g. chopped beef, pork, sweet filling) then steamed in corn husks.

turtle.def: Any land or marine reptile of the order Testudines, characterised by a protective shell enclosing its body. See also tortoise.
To flip over onto the back or top; to turn upside down.

tutu.def: A ballet skirt made of layered stiff but light netting.
to fiddle or mess around with something.

hut.def: A small, simple one-storey dwelling or shelter, often with just one room, and generally built of readily available local materials.
To provide (someone) with shelter in a hut.

bronze.def: A naturally occurring or man-made alloy of copper, usually in combination with tin, but also with one or more other metals.

backbone.def: The series of vertebrae, separated by disks, that encloses and protects the spinal cord, and runs down the middle of the back in vertebrate animals.

alligator.def: A member of the family Alligatoridae, which includes the caimans.
To crack in a pattern resembling an alligator's skin.

antler.def: A deciduous branching and bony structure on the head of deer (Cervidae), normally in pairs, grown and shed each year. (Compare with horn, which is generally not shed.)

comet.def: A celestial phenomenon with the appearance of such a body.

hobby.def: An activity that one enjoys doing in one's spare time.

tadpole.def: A young toad or frog in its larval stage of development that lives in water, has a tail and no legs, and, like a fish, breathes through gills.

pajamas.def: Clothes for wearing to bed and sleeping in, usually consisting of a loose-fitting shirt and pants/trousers.

coral.def: Any of many species of marine invertebrates in the class Anthozoa, most of which build hard calcium carbonate skeletons and form colonies, or a colony belonging to one of those species.

ebony.def: A hard, dense, deep black wood from various subtropical and tropical trees, especially of the genus Diospyros.

lavender.def: Any of a group of European plants, genus, Lavandula, of the mint family.
To decorate or perfume with lavender.

recipe.def: A formula for preparing or using a medicine; a prescription; also, a medicine prepared from such instructions.

tide.def: The daily fluctuation in the level of the sea caused by the gravitational influence of the moon and the sun.
To cause to float with the tide; to drive or carry with the tide or stream.

travel.def: To be on a journey, often for pleasure or business and with luggage; to go from one place to another.
The act of traveling; passage from place to place.

orchid.def: A plant of the orchid family (Orchidaceae), bearing unusually-shaped flowers of beautiful colours.

olive.def: A tree of species Olea europaea cultivated since ancient times in the Mediterranean for its fruit and the oil obtained from it.
Of a grayish green color, that of an unripe olive.

saffron.def: A plant of species Crocus sativus, a crocus.
To add saffron to (a food), for taste, colour etc.

tortoise.def: Synonym of cat (sense 11, a wheeled shelter)

pen.def: An enclosure (enclosed area) used to contain domesticated animals, especially sheep or cattle.

copper.def: A reddish-brown metallic chemical element (symbol Cu) with the atomic number 29; also, the metal made up of this element.
To coat or sheathe (something) with copper (etymology 1, noun sense 1).

chair.def: An item of furniture used to sit on or in, comprising a seat, legs or wheels, back, and sometimes arm rests, for use by one person.
To act as chairperson at; to preside over.

lilac.def: A large shrub of the genus Syringa, especially Syringa vulgaris, bearing white, pale-pink, or purple flowers.

salmon.def: One of several species of fish, typically of the Salmoninae subfamily, brownish above with silvery sides and delicate pinkish-orange flesh; they ascend rivers to spawn.
To ride a bicycle the wrong way down a one-way street.

rose.def: A shrub of the genus Rosa, with red, pink, white or yellow flowers.
To make rose-colored; to redden or flush.
Having a purplish-red or pink color; rosy.

tin.def: A malleable, ductile, metallic element, resistant to corrosion, with atomic number 50 and symbol Sn.
To place into a metal can (ie. a tin; be it tin, steel, aluminum) in order to preserve.

chairperson.def: A chairman or chairwoman, someone who presides over a meeting, board, etc.

alloy.def: A metal that is a combination of two or more elements, at least one of which is a metal, a base metal.
To mix or combine; often used of metals.

chainsaw.def: A power saw that has a power-driven and fast-revolving chain of metal teeth, usually used to cut trees.

chain.def: A series of interconnected rings or links usually made of metal.
To fasten something with a chain.

turquoise.def: A sky-blue, greenish-blue, or greenish-gray semi-precious gemstone.

sill.def: A breast wall; window breast; horizontal brink which forms the base of a window.

silly.def: Laughable or amusing through foolishness or a foolish appearance.

sienna.def: A form of clay containing iron and manganese.

retreat.def: The act of pulling back or withdrawing, as from something dangerous, or unpleasant.
To withdraw from a position, go back.

fascism.def: Any right-wing, authoritarian, nationalist ideology characterized by centralized, totalitarian governance, strong regimentation of the economy and society, and repression of criticism or opposition.

however.def: Nevertheless; yet, still; in spite of that.

teal.def: Any of various small freshwater ducks of the genus Anas that are brightly coloured and have short necks.

slate.def: A flake or piece of certain types of stone that tend to cleave into thin layers.
Having the bluish-grey colour of slate (noun etymology 1, noun sense 4).
To cover (a building, or part of a building such as a floor or roof) with slates (noun etymology 1, noun sense 1.1).

vermilion.def: A vivid red synthetic pigment made of mercury sulfide, cinnabar.

helicopter.def: An aircraft that is borne along by one or more sets of long rotating blades which allow it to hover, move in any direction including reverse, or land; and typically having a smaller set of blades on its tail to stabilize the aircraft.

moose.def: The largest member of the deer family (Alces americanus, sometimes included in Alces alces), of which the male has very large, palmate antlers.

mosquito.def: A small flying insect of the family Culicidae, the females of which bite humans and animals and suck blood, leaving an itching bump on the skin, and sometimes carrying diseases like malaria, dengue and yellow fever.
To fly close to the ground, seemingly without a course.

gun.def: A device for shooting projectiles or ditto (a shooter), functioning through stored energy: a firearm, cannon, harpoon gun/spear gun, raygun, etc, not a bow and arrow, or slingshot.

hibernate.def: To spend the winter in a dormant or inactive state of minimal activity, low body temperature, slow breathing and heart rate, and low metabolic rate; to go through a winter sleep.

goodbye.def: An utterance of goodbye, the wishing of farewell to someone.
To say goodbye; to wish somebody farewell on parting.

primrose.def: A flowering plant of the genus Primula.

amber.def: Ambergris, the waxy product of the sperm whale.
Of a brownish yellow colour, like that of most amber.
To perfume or flavour with ambergris.

sidewinder.def: A North American rattlesnake, Crotalus cerastes, that inhabits lowland deserts.

enough.def: An instance of being sufficient, or of doing something sufficiently.

computing.def: The process or act of calculation.

calculator.def: A mechanical or electronic device that performs mathematical calculations; (now usually) an electronic one specifically.

boss.def: A person who oversees and directs the work of others; a supervisor.
To exercise authoritative control over; to tell (someone) what to do, often repeatedly.

tangerine.def: A slightly ovoid, orange-coloured citrus fruit with a rough peel and a sour-sweet taste which is larger than a clementine and sometimes classed as a variety of mandarin orange.

city.def: A large settlement, bigger than a town; sometimes with a specific legal definition, depending on the place.

civic.def: Of, relating to, or belonging to a city, a citizen, or citizenship; municipal or civil.

civics.def: The study of good citizenship and proper membership in a community.

civil.def: Having to do with people and government office as opposed to the military or religion.

civilian.def: A person following the pursuits of civil life, especially one who is not an active member of the armed forces.
Not related to the military, police or other governmental professions.

clergy.def: A body of persons, such as priests, who are trained and ordained for religious service.

minister.def: A person who is trained to preach, to perform religious ceremonies, and to afford pastoral care at a Protestant church.
To attend to (the needs of); to tend; to take care (of); to give aid; to give service.

priest.def: A religious clergyman (clergywoman, clergyperson) who is trained to perform services or sacrifices at a church or temple.

mustard.def: A plant of certain species of the genus Brassica, or of related genera (especially Sinapis alba, in the family Brassicaceae, with yellow flowers, and linear seed pods).

strawberry.def: The sweet, usually red, edible accessory fruit of certain plants of the genus Fragaria.
Containing or having the flavor of strawberries.

scarlet.def: A brilliant red colour sometimes tinged with orange.
To dye or tinge (something) with scarlet.

lemon.def: Containing or having the flavour/flavor and/or scent of lemons.

tower.def: A tall, narrow structure (significantly taller than it is wide, either standing alone or forming part of a larger structure.

diesel.def: A fuel derived from petroleum (or other oils) but heavier than gasoline/petrol. Used to power diesel engines which burn this fuel using the heat produced when air is compressed.
To ignite a substance by using the heat generated by compression.

grape.def: A small, round, smooth-skinned edible fruit, usually purple, red, or green, that grows in bunches on female vines of most species of genus Vitis and the self-fertile plants of species Vitis vinifera.
Containing grapes or having a grape flavor.

cinnamon.def: A small evergreen tree native to Sri Lanka and southern India, Cinnamomum verum or Cinnamomum zeylanicum, belonging to the family Lauraceae.
Containing cinnamon, or having a cinnamon taste.

emerald.def: Any of various green gemstones, especially a green transparent form of beryl, highly valued as a precious stone.
To ornament with, or as if with, emeralds; to make green.

avocado.def: The large, usually yellowish-green or black, savory fruit of the avocado tree.

guacamole.def: An avocado-based greenish dip with onions, tomato, and spices, common to Mexican cuisine and often served with tortilla chips.

tortilla.def: A type of Mexican flatbread made out of cornmeal or flour.

omelette.def: A dish made with beaten eggs cooked in a frying pan without stirring, flipped over to cook on both sides, and sometimes filled or topped with other foodstuffs, for example cheese or chives.

guava.def: A tropical tree or shrub of the myrtle family, Psidium guajava.

salsa.def: A spicy tomato sauce of Mexican origin, often including onions and hot peppers.

epilepsy.def: A medical condition in which the sufferer experiences seizures (or convulsions) and blackouts.

epilogue.def: A short speech, spoken directly at the audience at the end of a play

episode.def: An incident, action, or time period standing out by itself, but more or less connected with a complete series of events.

equinox.def: The circumstance of a twenty-four hour time period having the day and night of equal length.

rice.def: Cereal plants, Oryza sativa of the grass family whose seeds are used as food.
To squeeze through a ricer; to mash or make into rice-sized pieces (especially potatoes).

squid.def: Any of several carnivorous marine cephalopod mollusks, of the order Teuthida, having a mantle, eight arms, and a pair of tentacles
To fish with a squid fishhook.

conch.def: A marine gastropod of the family Strombidae which lives in its own spiral shell.
To refine the flavour and texture of chocolate by warming and grinding, either in a traditional concher, or between rollers.

ray.def: A beam of light or radiation.
To emit something as if in rays.

auburn.def: A dark reddish-brown colour, often used to describe hair colour.

egg.def: An approximately spherical or ellipsoidal body produced by birds, insects, reptiles, and other animals, housing the embryo within a membrane or shell during its development.
To throw (especially rotten) eggs (noun sense 1.1.1) at (someone or something).

hazel.def: A tree or shrub of the genus Corylus, bearing edible nuts called hazelnuts or filberts.
Of a greenish-brown colour. (often used to refer to eye colour)

colour.def: Commonwealth and Ireland standard spelling of color.
Commonwealth and Ireland standard spelling of color.
Commonwealth and Ireland standard spelling of color.

ruby.def: A clear, deep, red variety of corundum, valued as a precious stone.
Of a deep, red color; ruby-red.

sapphire.def: A clear deep blue variety of corundum, valued as a precious stone.

chestnut.def: An edible nut (technically a fruit) of the Spanish chestnut or sweet chestnut tree (Castanea sativa); also (chiefly preceded by a descriptive word), a nut from a related shrub or tree; or a similar nut from an unrelated plant.
Of a deep reddish-brown colour, like that of a chestnut fruit (noun sense 1).

charcoal.def: impure carbon obtained by destructive distillation of wood or other organic matter, that is, heating it in the absence of oxygen.

carmine.def: A purplish-red pigment, made from dye obtained from the cochineal beetle; carminic acid or any of its derivatives.
Of the purplish red colour shade carmine.

carnation.def: A type of Eurasian plant widely cultivated for its flowers.
Of a rosy pink or red colour.

amethyst.def: A transparent purple to violet variety of quartz with traces of manganese, used as a gemstone.
Having a colour similar to that of the gemstone

buff.def: Undyed leather from the skin of buffalo or similar animals.
Of the color of buff leather, a brownish yellow.
To polish and make shiny by rubbing.

unveil.def: To remove a veil from; to uncover; to reveal something hidden.

masquerade.def: An assembly or party of people wearing (usually elaborate or fanciful) masks and costumes, and amusing themselves with dancing, conversation, or other diversions.
To take part in a masquerade; to assemble in masks and costumes; (loosely) to wear a disguise.

marinara.def: Prepared with tomatoes, or in a tomato sauce.
