apostrophe.def: The text character ’, which serves as a punctuation mark in various languages and as a diacritical mark in certain rare contexts.

bible.def: A comprehensive manual that describes something, or a publication with a loyal readership.

deity.def: Synonym of divinity: the state, position, or fact of being a god.

crown.def: A royal, imperial or princely headdress; a diadem.
Of, related to, or pertaining to a crown.
To place a crown on the head of.

covenant.def: An agreement to do or not do a particular thing.
To enter into, or promise something by, a covenant.

courage.def: The quality of being confident, not afraid or easily intimidated, but without being incautious or inconsiderate.

cute.def: Lovable, charming, attractive or pleasing, especially in a youthful, dainty, quaint or fun-spirited way.

electron.def: The subatomic particle having a negative charge and orbiting the nucleus; the flow of electrons in a conductor constitutes electricity.

emit.def: To send out or give off.

energy.def: The impetus behind all motion and all activity.

feminine.def: Of or pertaining to the female gender.

horizontal.def: Perpendicular to the vertical; parallel to the plane of the horizon; level, flat.
A horizontal component of a structure.

malleable.def: Able to be hammered into thin sheets; capable of being extended or shaped by beating with a hammer, or by the pressure of rollers.

orbit.def: The curved path of one object around a point or another body.
To circle or revolve around another object or position.

artery.def: Any of the muscular- and elastic-walled blood vessels forming part of the circulation system by which blood is conveyed away from the heart regardless of its oxygenation status; see pulmonary artery.

vein.def: A blood vessel that transports blood from the capillaries back to the heart.
To mark with veins or a vein-like pattern.

sorry.def: Regretful or apologetic for one's actions.
The act of saying sorry; an apology.

prince.def: A (male) ruler, a sovereign; a king, monarch.
To behave or act like a prince.

princess.def: A female member of a royal family other than a queen, especially a daughter or granddaughter of a monarch.

emperor.def: The male monarch or ruler of an empire.

empress.def: The female monarch (ruler) of an empire.

empire.def: A political state, often a monarchy, that has achieved a much greater current size than its initial size by conquering surrounding territories, cities or nations.
Following or imitating a style popular during the First French Empire (1804–1814).

monarchy.def: A government in which sovereignty is embodied within a single, today usually hereditary head of state (whether as a figurehead or as a powerful ruler).

nobleman.def: A peer; an aristocrat; ranks range from baron to king to emperor.

baron.def: The male ruler of a barony.

duke.def: The male ruler of a duchy (female equivalent: duchess).
To hit or beat with the fists.

duchess.def: The wife or widow of a duke.
to court or curry favour for political or business advantage; to flatter obsequiously.

duchy.def: A dominion or region ruled by a duke or duchess.

countess.def: The wife of a count or earl.

county.def: The land ruled by a count or a countess.
Characteristic of a ‘county family’; representative of the gentry or aristocracy of a county.

state.def: A condition; a set of circumstances applying at any given time.
To declare to be a fact.

federation.def: Act of joining together into a single political entity.
Of an architectural style popular around the time of federation.

earl.def: A British or Irish nobleman next in rank above a viscount and below a marquess; equivalent to a European count. A female using the style is termed a countess.

organ.def: The larger part of an organism, composed of tissues that perform similar functions.
To supply with an organ or organs; to fit with organs.

organism.def: A discrete and complete living thing, such as animal, plant, fungus or microorganism.

digestion.def: The process, in the gastrointestinal tract, by which food is converted into substances that can be used by the body.

vertical.def: Standing, pointing, or moving straight up or down; parallel to the local direction of gravity; along the direction of a plumb line; perpendicular to something horizontal.

dagger.def: A stabbing weapon, similar to a sword but with a short, double-edged blade.
To pierce with a dagger; to stab.

monarch.def: The ruler of an absolute monarchy or the head of state of a constitutional monarchy.

analog.def: In which the value of a data item (such as time) is represented by a continuous(ly) variable physical quantity that can be measured (such as the shadow of a sundial).
Something that bears an analogy to something else.

subpoena.def: A motive or thing which can compel or demand something, or summon someone.

To summon (someone) with a subpoena (noun sense 1) to appear in court, or at a deposition or some other legal proceeding, as a witness to give testimony or to produce evidence; to serve a subpoena on (someone).

tissue.def: To form tissue of; to interweave.

people.def: Persons forming or belonging to a particular group, such as a nation, class, ethnic group, country, family, etc.
To interact with people; to socialize.

dictatorship.def: A type of government where absolute sovereignty is allotted to an individual or a small clique.

dictator.def: A totalitarian leader of a country, nation, or government.

totalitarian.def: Of or relating to a system of government where the people have virtually no authority and the state wields absolute control of every aspect of the country, socially, financially, and politically.

election.def: A process of choosing a leader, members of parliament, councillors, or other representatives by popular vote.

vote.def: A formalized choice on legally relevant measures such as employment or appointment to office or a proceeding about a legal dispute.
To cast a vote; to assert a formalized choice in an election.

communist.def: Of, relating to, supporting, or advocating communism.
An advocate of a society based on the common ownership of property; a proponent of communism.

communism.def: Any far-left political ideology or philosophy advocating holding the production of resources collectively, especially by seizing it through revolution.

socialism.def: Any of various economic and political theories advocating collective or governmental ownership and administration of the means of production and distribution of goods.

samurai.def: In feudal Japan, a soldier who served a daimyo.

bushido.def: An ethical code of the samurai that was prevalent in feudal Japan that advocated unquestioning loyalty to the master at all costs and obedience in all deeds, valuing honor above life.

daimyo.def: A lord during the Japanese feudal period.

katana.def: A type of Japanese longsword, having a single edge and slight curvature, historically used by samurai and ninja.

tanto.def: A traditional Japanese small sword or knife; often used as a secondary weapon to a katana.

hilt.def: The handle of a sword, consisting of grip, guard, and pommel, designed to facilitate use of the blade and afford protection to the hand.

handle.def: The part of an object which is (designed to be) held in the hand when used or moved.
To touch; to feel or hold with the hand(s).

shogun.def: The supreme generalissimo of feudal Japan.

generalissimo.def: A supreme commander of the armed forces of a country, especially one who is also a political leader.

san.def: An Ancient Greek letter representing /s/ (uppercase Ϻ, lowercase ϻ), originally used in some dialects instead of sigma.

rin.def: A coin worth ¹⁄₁₀₀₀ of a Japanese yen, no longer in circulation.

display.def: To show conspicuously; to exhibit; to demonstrate; to manifest.

attachment.def: The act or process of (physically or figuratively) attaching.

klingon.def: A member of an alien warrior race in the Star Trek universe with distinctive forehead ridges and a culture based on the strict observance of honor, loyalty, and combat.

still.def: A period of calm or silence.

seep.def: To ooze or pass slowly through pores or other small openings, and in overly small quantities; said of liquids, etc.
A small spring, pool, or other spot where liquid from the ground (e.g. water, petroleum or tar) has oozed to the surface; a place of seeping.

gaggle.def: A group of geese when they are on the ground or on the water.
To make a noise like a goose; to cackle.

wedge.def: One of the simple machines; a piece of material, such as metal or wood, thick at one edge and tapered to a thin edge at the other for insertion in a narrow crevice, used for splitting, tightening, securing, or levering.
To support or secure using a wedge.

paddling.def: The act of using a paddle.

stop.def: A (usually marked) place where buses, trams or trains halt to let passengers get on and off, usually smaller than a station.

crowd.def: To press forward; to advance by pushing.
A group of people congregated or collected into a close body without order.

stroke.def: An act of hitting; a blow, a hit.
To draw the horizontal line across the upright part (of the letter t).

washer.def: Something that washes; especially an appliance such as a washing machine or dishwasher.
To fit (a mechanical device) with a washer.

torque.def: To make something rotate about an axis by imparting torque to it.
A tightly braided necklace or collar, often made of metal, worn by various early European peoples.

throttle.def: A valve that regulates the supply of fuel-air mixture to an internal combustion engine and thus controls its speed; a similar valve that controls the air supply to an engine.
To control or adjust the speed of (an engine).

shock.def: Causing intense surprise, horror, etc.; unexpected and shocking.
To cause to be emotionally shocked; to cause (someone) to feel greatly surprised or upset.

screwdriver.def: A hand tool or power tool which engages with the head of a screw and allows torque to be applied to turn the screw, thus driving it in or loosening it.

nut.def: Any of various hard-shelled seeds or hard, dry fruits from various families of plants.

drill.def: To create (a hole) by removing material with a drill (tool).
A tool or machine used to remove material so as to create a hole, typically by plunging a rotating cutting bit into a stationary workpiece.

clutch.def: To seize, as though with claws.
The claw of a predatory animal or bird.
Performing or tending to perform well in difficult, high-pressure situations.

cylinder.def: A surface created by projecting a closed two-dimensional curve along an axis intersecting the plane of the curve.
To calender; to press (paper, etc.) between rollers to make it glossy.

valve.def: A device that controls the flow of a gas or fluid through a space, such as a pipe, manifold, or plenum.
To control (flow) by means of a valve.

artichoke.def: A plant related to the thistle with enlarged flower heads eaten as a vegetable while immature, Cynara cardunculus var. scolymus.

hazelnut.def: The fruit of the hazel, especially Corylus avellana, which is grown commercially.

batch.def: The quantity of bread or other baked goods baked at one time.
To aggregate things together into a batch.
Of a process, operating for a defined set of conditions, and then halting.

mandarin.def: A high government bureaucrat of the Chinese Empire.
Pertaining to or reminiscent of mandarins; deliberately superior or complex; esoteric, highbrow, obscurantist.

foal.def: A young horse or other equine, especially just after birth or less than a year old.
To give birth to (a foal); to bear offspring.

colt.def: To horse; to get with young.

calf.def: A young cow or bull of any bovid, such as domestic cattle or buffalo.

vessel.def: A craft for transportation on or in water, air, or space.

nozzle.def: A short tube, usually tapering, forming the vent of a hose or pipe.

settling.def: The act of one who, or that which, settles; the act of establishing oneself, of colonizing, subsiding, adjusting, etc.

tracer.def: A compound, element, or isotope used to track the progress or history of a natural process.

mor.def: A mid-ocean ridge: a submarine volcanic mountain range.

rate.def: To assign or be assigned a particular rank or level.

continuous.def: Without stopping; without a break, cessation, or interruption.

powder.def: The fine particles which are the result of reducing a dry substance by pounding, grinding, or triturating, or the result of decay; dust.
To reduce to fine particles; to pound, grind, or rub into a powder.

impersonal.def: Not personal; not representing a person; not having personality.

gram.def: A unit of mass equal to one-thousandth of a kilogram. Symbol: g.

flash.def: To cause to shine briefly or intermittently.
A sudden, short, temporary burst of light.
Expensive-looking and demanding attention; stylish; showy.

pass.def: An opening, road, or track, available for passing; especially, one through or over some dangerous or otherwise impracticable barrier such as a mountain range; a passageway; a defile; a ford.

dew.def: Any moisture from the atmosphere condensed by cool bodies upon their surfaces.
To wet with, or as if with, dew; to moisten.

exhaust.def: To draw or let out wholly; to drain completely.
A system consisting of the parts of an engine through which burned gases or steam are discharged; see also exhaust system.

hammer.def: A tool with a heavy head and a handle used for pounding.
To strike repeatedly with a hammer, some other implement, the fist, etc.

ewe.def: A female sheep, as opposed to a ram.
Of or pertaining to the Ewe people or language.

femme.def: A woman, a wife; (now chiefly Canada, US) a young woman or girl.
Pertaining to a femme; feminine, female.

humanoid.def: Having the appearance or characteristics of a human; being anthropomorphic under some criteria (physical, mental, genetical, ethological, ethical etc.).
A being having the appearance or characteristics of a human.

investigate.def: To inquire into or study in order to ascertain facts or information.

defeat.def: To overcome in battle or contest.
The act or instance of being defeated, of being overcome or vanquished; a loss.

zilch.def: A nobody: a person who is worthless in importance or character.
To cause to score nothing, to thoroughly defeat.

array.def: To clothe and ornament; to adorn or attire.

worship.def: The devotion accorded to a deity or to a sacred object.
To reverence (a deity, etc.) with supreme respect and veneration; to perform religious exercises in honour of.

prostitute.def: Debased, corrupt; seeking personal gain by dishonourable means.
Any person (especially a woman) who has sexual intercourse or engages in other sexual activity for payment, especially as a means of livelihood.
To offer (oneself or someone else) for sexual activity in exchange for money.

dingus.def: A gadget, device, or object whose name is either unknown, forgotten, or omitted for the purpose of humor.

celestial.def: Synonym of heavenly: of or related to Heaven and the divine.

peer.def: To look with difficulty, or as if searching for something.

perch.def: Any of the three species of spiny-finned freshwater fish in the genus Perca.
To rest on a perch (especially, of a bird); to roost.

bass.def: Of sound, a voice or an instrument, low in pitch or frequency.
A low spectrum of sound tones.
To sound in a deep tone.

beard.def: Facial hair on the chin, cheeks, jaw and neck.
To grow hair on the chin and jaw.

seem.def: To appear; to look outwardly; to be perceived as.

seam.def: A folded-back and stitched piece of fabric; especially, the stitching that joins two or more pieces of fabric.
To put together with a seam.

domain.def: A geographic area owned or controlled by a single person or organization.

profile.def: The outermost shape, view, or edge of an object.
To create a summary or collection of information about (a person, etc.).

convoluted.def: Having numerous overlapping coils or folds; convolute.

brewer.def: Someone who brews, or whose occupation is to prepare malt liquors.

brew.def: To make tea or coffee by mixing tea leaves or coffee beans with hot water.
The mixture formed by brewing; that which is brewed; a brewage, such as tea or beer.

home.def: Of, from, or pertaining to one’s dwelling or country; domestic; not foreign.

commission.def: A sending or mission (to do or accomplish something).
To send or officially charge someone or some group to do something.

pail.def: A vessel of wood, tin, plastic, etc., usually cylindrical and having a handle -- used especially for carrying liquids, for example water or milk; a bucket (sometimes with a cover).

upside.def: The highest or uppermost side or portion of something.

argentinian.def: A person from Argentina or of Argentine descent.
Of, from, or pertaining to Argentina and the Argentine people.

workshop.def: A room, especially one which is not particularly large, used for manufacturing or other light industrial work.
To help a playwright revise a draft of (a play) by rehearsing it with actors and critiquing the results.

funnel.def: A utensil in the shape of an inverted hollow cone terminating in a narrow pipe, for channeling liquids or granular material; typically used when transferring said substances from any container into ones with a significantly smaller opening.

connoisseur.def: A specialist in a given field whose opinion is highly valued, especially in one of the fine arts or in matters of taste.

stir.def: To disturb the relative position of the particles (of a liquid or similar) by passing an object through it.
The act or result of stirring (moving around the particles of a liquid etc.)

pour.def: To cause (liquid, or liquid-like substance) to flow in a stream, either out of a container or into it.

temporarily.def: For a limited period of time; not permanently.

ukrainian.def: Relating to Ukraine or its people or language.
A citizen of Ukraine or a person of Ukrainian ethnicity.

chemistry.def: The branch of natural science that deals with the composition and constitution of substances and the changes that they undergo as a consequence of alterations in the constitution of their molecules.

hyperbole.def: Deliberate or unintentional overstatement, particularly extreme overstatement.

teen.def: Synonym of teenager: a person between 13 and 19 years old (inclusive).
Of or having to do with teenagers; teenage
To excite; to provoke; to vex; to afflict; to injure.

pet.def: An animal kept as a companion or otherwise for pleasure, rather than for some practical benefit or use.
Favourite; cherished; the focus of one's (usually positive) attention.

waffle.def: A flat pastry pressed with a grid pattern, often eaten hot with butter and/or honey or syrup.

ebb.def: The receding movement of the tide.

content.def: To give contentment or satisfaction to; to satisfy; to make happy.

american.def: A citizen or national of the United States of America.
Of, from, or pertaining to the United States of America, its people, or its culture.

attorney.def: A lawyer; one who advises or represents others in legal matters as a profession.
To work as a legal attorney.

anime.def: An artistic style originating in, and associated with, Japanese animation, and that has also been adopted by a comparatively low number of animated works from other countries.

sensei.def: A martial arts instructor; especially one for a Japanese martial art.

dojo.def: A training facility, usually led by one or more sensei; a hall or room used for such training.

corporation.def: A body corporate, created by law or under authority of law, having a continuous existence independent of the existences of its members, and powers and liabilities distinct from those of its members.

ceo.def: To serve as the chief executive officer (CEO) of an organization or company.

corporate.def: Of or relating to the whole company.
A bond issued by the company.

party.def: A person or group of people constituting one side in a legal proceeding, such as in a legal action or a contract.
To celebrate at a party, to have fun, to enjoy oneself.

platform.def: A raised stage from which speeches are made and on which musical and other performances are made.
To furnish with or shape into a platform

plank.def: A long, broad and thick piece of timber, as opposed to a board which is less thick.

faction.def: A group of people, especially within a political organization, which expresses a shared belief or opinion different from people who are not part of the group.

opinion.def: A belief, judgment or perspective that a person has formed, either through objective or subjective reasoning, about a topic, issue, person or thing.
To have or express as an opinion.

fact.def: Something actual as opposed to invented.

objective.def: Of or relating to a material object, actual existence or reality.
A material object that physically exists.

subjective.def: Formed, as in opinions, based upon a person's feelings or intuition, rather than upon observation or purely logical reasoning; coming more from within the observer than from observations of the external environment.

observation.def: The act of observing, and the fact of being observed (see observance)

similarity.def: Closeness of appearance to something else.

quote.def: A statement attributed to a person; a quotation.
To repeat (the exact words of a person).

constitution.def: The act, or process of setting something up, or establishing something; the composition or structure of such a thing; its makeup.

revenue.def: The income returned by an investment.

price.def: The cost required to gain possession of something.
To determine the monetary value of (an item); to put a price on.

asset.def: A thing or quality that has value, especially one that generates cash flows.

deposit.def: Sediment or rock that is not native to its present location or is different from the surrounding material. Sometimes refers to ore or gems.
To lay down; to place; to put.

loan.def: An act or instance of lending, an act or instance of granting something for temporary use.

withdrawal.def: Receiving from someone's care what one has earlier entrusted to them. Usually refers to money.

ore.def: Rock or other material that contains valuable or utilitarian materials; primarily a rock containing metals or gems for which it is typically mined and processed.

gem.def: A precious stone, usually of substantial monetary value or prized for its beauty or shine.
To adorn with, or as if with, gems.

gemstone.def: A gem, usually made of minerals.

kin.def: Related by blood or marriage, akin. (It is more common to form sentences using the noun instead.)
To identify with; as in spiritually connect to a fictional or non-fictional being.

yonder.def: At or in a distant but indicated place.
The farther, the more distant of two choices.
The vast distance, particularly the sky or trackless forest.

hydrogen.def: The lightest chemical element (symbol H), with an atomic number of 1 and atomic weight of 1.008.

henry.def: In the International System of Units, the derived unit of electrical inductance; the inductance induced in a circuit by a rate of change of current of one ampere per second and a resulting electromotive force of one volt. Symbol: H

manchu.def: A person belonging to or descended from the indigenous people of Manchuria.
Manchurian, referring to the Manchu(rian) people.

eloquence.def: The quality of artistry and persuasiveness in speech or writing.

thermometer.def: An apparatus used to measure temperature.

civilization.def: An organized culture encompassing many communities, often on the scale of a nation or a people; a stage or system of social, political, or technical development.

civilisation.def: UK, Ireland, Australia, New Zealand, South Africa, Hong Kong, and Commonwealth spelling of civilization.

band.def: A strip of material used for strengthening or coupling.

mock.def: An imitation, usually of lesser quality.

girlfriend.def: A female partner in an unmarried romantic relationship.

boyfriend.def: A male partner in an unmarried romantic relationship.

hindi.def: In or relating to the Hindi language.

transsexual.def: Of a person, having changed, or being in the process of changing, physical sex by undergoing medical treatment, such as hormone replacement therapy (HRT) and/or optionally sex reassignment surgery (SRS).

governor.def: The chief executive officer of a first-level administrative division of a country.

leader.def: Any person who leads or directs.

mayor.def: The chief executive of the municipal government of a city, borough, etc., formerly (historical) usually appointed as a caretaker by European royal courts but now usually appointed or elected locally.

singularity.def: The state of being singular, distinct, peculiar, uncommon or unusual.

proton.def: A positively charged subatomic particle forming part of the nucleus of an atom and determining the atomic number of an element, composed of two up quarks and a down quark.

neutron.def: A subatomic particle forming part of the nucleus of an atom and having no charge; it is a combination of an up quark and two down quarks.

hoop.def: A circular band of metal used to bind a barrel.
To bind or fasten using a hoop.

pub.def: A public house where beverages, primarily alcoholic, may be bought and consumed, also providing food and sometimes entertainment such as live music or television.
To go to one or more public houses.

moron.def: A stupid person; an idiot; a fool.

delegate.def: A person authorized to act as representative for another; a deputy.
To commit tasks and responsibilities to others, especially subordinates.

harem.def: The private section of a Muslim household forbidden to male strangers.

dissertation.def: A formal exposition of a subject, especially a research paper that students write in order to complete the requirements for a doctoral degree in the US and a non-doctoral degree in the UK; a thesis.

sabbath.def: Friday, observed in Islam as a day of rest and worship.

blooming.def: A euphemism for the intensifier bloody.
The act by which something blooms.

squash.def: A sport played in a walled court with a soft rubber ball and bats like tennis racquets.
To beat or press into pulp or a flat mass; to crush.

obsolete.def: No longer in use; gone into disuse; disused or neglected (often in favour of something newer).

zoology.def: The part of biology relating to the animal kingdom, including the structure, embryology, evolution, classification, habits, and distribution of all animals, both living and extinct.

gourmet.def: A connoisseur in eating and drinking; someone who takes their food seriously.

grooming.def: Care for one's personal appearance, hygiene, and clothing.

ripen.def: to grow ripe; to become mature (said of grain, fruit, flowers etc.)

mildew.def: A growth of minute powdery or webby fungi, whitish or of different colors, found on various diseased or decaying substances.

molding.def: The act or process of shaping in or on a mold, or of making molds; the art or occupation of a molder.

scouring.def: The act of cleaning a surface by rubbing it with a brush, soap and water.

lifting.def: The action or process by which something is lifted; elevation

poor.def: With no or few possessions or money, particularly in relation to contemporaries who do have them.
The poor people of a society or the world collectively, the poor class of a society.
Synonym of impoverish, to make poor.

burglary.def: The crime of unlawfully breaking into a vehicle, house, store, or other enclosure with the intent to steal.

orient.def: The part of the horizon where the sun first appears in the morning; the east.
To build or place (something) so as to face eastward.

devising.def: the act of creating a plan or some object, especially a will

device.def: Any piece of equipment made for a particular purpose, especially a mechanical or electrical one.

kannada.def: The Dravidian language that is the official language of the state of Karnataka, India.

menu.def: The details of the food to be served at a banquet; a bill of fare.

organizer.def: A person who arranges the details of a public event.

note.def: To notice with care; to observe; to remark; to heed.

password.def: A word relayed to a person to gain admittance to a place or to gain access to information.

skyscraper.def: A very tall building with a large number of floors.

outage.def: A temporary suspension of operation, especially of electrical power supply.

suspension.def: The act of suspending, or the state of being suspended.

plea.def: An appeal, petition, urgent prayer or entreaty.

suit.def: A set of clothes to be worn together, now especially a man's matching jacket and trousers (also business suit or lounge suit), or a similar outfit for a woman.
To make proper or suitable; to adapt or fit.

mop.def: An implement for washing floors or similar, made of a piece of cloth, or a collection of thrums, or coarse yarn, fastened to a handle.
To rub, scrub, clean or wipe with a mop, or as if with a mop.

floor.def: The interior bottom or surface of a house or building; the supporting surface of a room.
To cover or furnish with a floor.

scrub.def: A thicket or jungle, often specified by the name of the prevailing plant.
To rub hard; to wash with rubbing; usually, to rub with a wet brush, or with something coarse or rough, for the purpose of cleaning or brightening

humid.def: Containing perceptible moisture (usually describing air or atmosphere); damp; moist; somewhat wet or watery.

moisture.def: That which moistens or makes damp or wet; exuding fluid; liquid in small quantity.

charade.def: A genre of riddles where the clues to the answer are descriptions or puns on its syllables, with a final clue to the whole.
To act out a charade (of); to gesture; to pretend.

backlash.def: A suddenly reversed or backward motion, such as of a rope or elastic band when it snaps under tension.
To perform a backlash, to lash back in reaction to some cause.

lash.def: The thong or braided cord of a whip, with which the blow is given.
To strike with a lash; to whip or scourge with a lash, or with something like one.

mark.def: To put a mark on (something); to make (something) recognizable by a mark; to label or write on (something).

forever.def: For all time, for all eternity; for a lifetime; for an infinite amount of time.

homosexual.def: Sexually and/or romantically attracted to members of the same sex, such as a man who is attracted to men or a woman who is attracted to women; gay. (Typically used in the sense of sole/exclusive attraction.)
A person who is sexually attracted solely or primarily to others of the same sex.

dump.def: A place where waste or garbage is left; a ground or place for dumping ashes, refuse, etc.; a disposal site.
To release, especially in large quantities and chaotic manner.

community.def: A group sharing common characteristics, such as the same language, law, religion, or tradition.

therefore.def: Consequently, by or in consequence of that or this cause; referring to something previously stated.

wherefore.def: Why, for what reason, because of what.
An intent or purpose; a why.

incorrigible.def: Defective and impossible to materially correct or set aright.

franc.def: Any of several units of currency.

outlet.def: A vent or similar passage to allow the escape of something.

wire.def: Metal formed into a thin, even thread, now usually by being drawn through a hole in a steel die.
To fasten with wire, especially with reference to wine bottles, corks, or fencing.

reason.def: To deduce or come to a conclusion by being rational.

dutchman.def: A Dutch man; a man from the Netherlands.

want.def: To wish for or desire (something); to feel a need or desire for; to crave, hanker, or demand.

employee.def: A person who provides labor to a company or another person.

profit.def: Total income or cash flow minus expenditures. The money or other benefit a non-governmental organization or individual receives in exchange for products and services sold at an advertised price.
To benefit (somebody), be of use to (somebody).

sweat.def: Fluid that exits the body through pores in the skin usually due to physical stress and/or high temperature for the purpose of regulating body temperature and removing certain compounds from the circulation.

fertilizer.def: A natural substance that is used to make the ground more suitable for growing plants.

maintenance.def: Actions performed to keep some machine or system functioning or in service.

monopoly.def: A situation, by legal privilege or other agreement, in which solely one party (company, cartel etc.) exclusively provides a particular product or service, dominating that market and generally exerting powerful control over it.

feasible.def: Able to be done in practice.

education.def: The process of imparting knowledge, skill and judgment.

awareness.def: The state or level of consciousness where sense data can be confirmed by an observer.

consciousness.def: The state of being conscious or aware; awareness.

spectrum.def: A range; a continuous, infinite, one-dimensional set, possibly bounded by extremes.

extremes.def: The opposite ends of a range or scale.

things.def: One's clothes, furniture, luggage, or possessions collectively; stuff

perception.def: The organisation, identification and interpretation of sensory information.

manifest.def: Evident to the senses, especially to the sight; apparent; distinctly perceived.
A list or invoice of the passengers or goods being carried by a commercial vehicle or ship.
To show plainly; to make to appear distinctly, usually to the mind; to put beyond question or doubt; to display; to exhibit.

accounting.def: The development and use of a system for recording and analyzing the financial transactions and financial status of an individual or a business.

individual.def: A person considered alone, rather than as belonging to a group of people.
Relating to a single person or thing as opposed to more than one.

developer.def: A person or entity engaged in the creation or improvement of certain classes of products.

fork.def: Any of several types of pronged (tined) tools (physical tools), as follows:
To divide into two or more branches or copies.

kosher.def: Fit for use or consumption, in accordance with Jewish law (especially relating to food).
In a kosher manner; in accordance with kashrut.
To kasher; to prepare (for example, meat) in conformity with the requirements of the Jewish law.

pager.def: A wireless telecommunications device that receives text or voice messages.

transparent.def: See-through, clear; having the property that light passes through it almost undisturbed, such that one can see through it clearly.

paradigm.def: A pattern, a way of doing something; especially a pattern of thought, a system of beliefs, a conceptual framework.

restaurant.def: An eating establishment in which diners are served food, usually by waiters at their tables but sometimes (as in a fast food restaurant) at a counter.

utopia.def: A world in which everything and everyone works in perfect harmony.

television.def: An electronic communication medium that allows the transmission of real-time visual images, and often sound.

ejector.def: One who, or that which, ejects or dispossesses.

steam.def: The hot gaseous form of water, formed when water changes from the liquid phase to the gas phase (at or above its boiling point temperature).
Old-fashioned; from before the digital age.

mechanics.def: The branch of physics that deals with the action of forces on material objects with mass

chassis.def: The base frame of a vehicle, such as a motor vehicle.

electronic.def: Of or pertaining to an electron or electrons.
A device which runs on electricity.

circuit.def: The act of moving or revolving around, or as in a circle or orbit; a revolution
To move in a circle; to go round; to circulate.

lever.def: A rigid piece which is capable of turning about one point, or axis (fulcrum), and in which are two or more other points where forces are applied; — used for transmitting and modifying force and motion.

salary.def: A fixed amount of money paid to a worker, usually calculated on a monthly or annual basis, not hourly, as wages. Implies a degree of professionalism and/or autonomy.
To pay on the basis of a period of a week or longer, especially to convert from another form of compensation.

punishment.def: A penalty to punish wrongdoing, especially for crime.

neapolitan.def: Of, from or relating to the city of Naples, capital and largest city of Campania, Italy, or the surrounding metropolitan city.
A native or inhabitant of the city of Naples, capital and largest city of Campania, Italy, or the surrounding metropolitan city.

venetian.def: Of, from or relating to the city of Venice or surrounding province, Veneto region, northeastern Italy.
A native or inhabitant of the city of Venice or surrounding province, Veneto region, northeastern Italy.

accommodate.def: To render fit, suitable, or correspondent; to adapt.
Suitable; fit; adapted; as, means accommodate to end.

lava.def: The molten rock ejected by a volcano from a vent such as a crater or fissure; magma that has breached the surface of the earth.

thanks.def: An expression of appreciation or gratitude.

recycle.def: To break down and reuse component materials.

trash.def: Useless physical things to be discarded; rubbish; refuse.

laurel.def: An evergreen shrub of species Laurus nobilis, having aromatic leaves of a lanceolate shape, with clusters of small, yellowish white flowers in their axils.
To decorate with laurel, especially with a laurel wreath.

laureate.def: One crowned with laurel, such as a poet laureate or Nobel laureate.
To honor with a wreath of laurel, as formerly was done in bestowing a degree at English universities.

launder.def: To wash; to wash, and to smooth with a flatiron or mangle; to wash and iron.

launch.def: To throw (a projectile such as a lance, dart or ball); to hurl; to propel with force.
The movement of a vessel from land into the water; especially, the sliding on ways from the stocks on which it is built. (Compare: to splash a ship.)

whither.def: A place to which someone or something goes; also, a condition to which someone or something moves.
To cause (someone) to hurry; to hasten, to hurry.

whence.def: From where; from which place or source.

laughter.def: The sound of laughing, produced by air so expelled; any similar sound.

thence.def: From there, from that place or from that time.

regret.def: To feel sorry about (a thing that has or has not happened), afterthink: to wish that a thing had not happened, that something else had happened instead.
Emotional pain on account of something done or experienced in the past, with a wish that it had been different; a looking back with dissatisfaction or with longing.

ignore.def: To deliberately not listen or pay attention to.

friendly.def: Generally warm, approachable and easy to relate with in character.
A game which is of no consequence in terms of ranking, betting, etc.
In a friendly manner; like a friend.

halal.def: Allowable, according to Muslim religious customs, to have or do.
In a halal manner; in accordance with Muslim religious customs.

pragmatic.def: Practical, concerned with making decisions and actions that are useful in practice, not just theory.

laudanum.def: Any of several tinctures of opium, once widely used for various medical purposes and as a recreational drug.
To add laudanum to (a drink or the like).

dice.def: Gaming with one or more dice.

slogan.def: A distinctive phrase of a person or group of people (such as a movement or political party); a motto.

safety.def: The condition or feeling of being safe; security; certainty.
To secure (a mechanical component, as in aviation) to keep it from becoming detached even under vibration.

produce.def: To bring forth, to yield, make, manufacture, or otherwise generate.

problem.def: A difficulty that has to be resolved or dealt with.
Difficult to train or guide; unruly.

own.def: Belonging to; possessed; acquired; proper to; property of; titled to; held in one's name; under/using the name of. Often marks a possessive determiner as reflexive, referring back to the subject of the clause or sentence.
To have rightful possession of (property, goods or capital); to have legal title to; to acquire a property or asset.

secure.def: Free from attack or danger; protected.
To make safe; to relieve from apprehensions of, or exposure to, danger; to guard; to protect.

vague.def: Not clearly expressed; stated in indefinite terms.
to wander; to roam; to stray.

accuser.def: One who accuses; one who brings a charge of crime or fault.

pop.def: A loud, sharp sound, as of a cork coming out of a bottle, especially when the contents are pressurized by fizziness.
To make a pop, or sharp, quick sound.

degree.def: A stage of proficiency or qualification in a course of study, now especially an award bestowed by a university/college, as a certification of academic achievement. (In the United States, can include secondary schools.)

psycho.def: A person who is psychotic, psychopathic, or (broadly) otherwise insane.

mozzarella.def: Soft Italian or Italian-style cheese made from cow's or buffalo's milk and commonly used as a pizza topping and in salads etc.

infinity.def: endlessness, unlimitedness, absence of a beginning, end or limits to size.

way.def: To do with a place or places.

will.def: Used to express the future tense, sometimes with an implication of volition or determination when used in the first person. Compare shall.
One's independent faculty of choice; the ability to be able to exercise one's choice or intention.

shall.def: Used before a verb to indicate the simple future tense in the first person singular or plural.

should.def: Ought to; indicating opinion, advice, or instruction, about what is required or desirable.
Something that ought to be the case as opposed to already being the case.

might.def: Power, strength, force, or influence held by a person or group.

could.def: Something that could happen, or could be the case, under different circumstances; a potentiality.

must.def: To do as a requirement; indicates that the sentence subject is required as an imperative or directive to execute the sentence predicate, with failure to do so resulting in a failure or negative consequence.
Something that is mandatory, required or recommended.

mission.def: A set of tasks that fulfills a purpose or duty; an assignment set by an employer, or by oneself.

missionary.def: One who is sent on a mission.

ministry.def: Government department, at the administrative level normally headed by a minister (or equivalent rank, e.g. secretary of state), who holds it as portfolio, especially in a constitutional monarchy, but also as a polity

creed.def: That which is believed; accepted doctrine, especially religious doctrine; a particular set of beliefs; any summary of principles or opinions professed or adhered to.

communion.def: A joining together of minds or spirits; a mental connection.

sacrament.def: A sacred act and the attendant ceremony, considered (theology) an outward sign of divine grace, instituted by Jesus Christ.

consecrate.def: To declare something holy, or make it holy by some procedure.

holy.def: Dedicated to a religious purpose or a god.
A thing that is extremely holy; used almost exclusively in Holy of Holies.

divine.def: Of or pertaining to a god.
One skilled in divinity; a theologian.
To foretell (something), especially by the use of divination.

unholy.def: Not holy; (by extension) evil, impure, or otherwise perverted.

secular.def: Not specifically religious; lay or civil, as opposed to clerical.
A secular ecclesiastic, or one not bound by monastic rules.

worldly.def: Concerned with human or earthly matters, physical as opposed to spiritual.

eternal.def: One who lives forever; an immortal.

supernatural.def: Above nature; beyond or added to nature, often so considered because it is given by a deity or some force beyond that with which humans are born.

unnatural.def: One who is unnatural, against nature, perverse.

ordinary.def: A person with authority; authority, ordinance.
Having regular jurisdiction; now only used in certain phrases.

extraordinary.def: Anything that goes beyond what is ordinary.

pure.def: Free of flaws or imperfections; unsullied.
to a great extent or degree; extremely; exceedingly.
To hit (the ball) completely cleanly and accurately.

bless.def: To make something holy by religious rite, sanctify.

blessed.def: Having divine aid, or protection, or other blessing.

cursed.def: Under some divine harm, malady, or other curse.

condemned.def: Having received a curse to be doomed to suffer eternally.

curse.def: A supernatural detriment or hindrance; a bane.
To place a curse upon (a person or object).

doomed.def: Assured to suffer death, failure, or a similarly negative outcome.

doom.def: To pronounce judgment or sentence on; to condemn.

blessing.def: Some kind of divine or supernatural aid, or reward.

condemn.def: To strongly criticise or denounce; to excoriate.

christ.def: A figure or other artistic depiction of Jesus Christ.

messiah.def: The one who is ordained by God to lead the people of Israel, believed by Christians and Muslims to be Jesus Christ.

minion.def: A loyal servant of another, usually a more powerful being.

cherub.def: A winged angel, described by Pseudo-Dionysius the Areopagite (c. 5th–6th century) as the second highest order of angels, ranked above thrones and below seraphim.

plane.def: Of a surface: flat or level.

bow.def: A weapon made of a curved piece of wood or other flexible material whose ends are connected by a string, used for shooting arrows.
To play music on (a stringed) instrument using a bow.

lutheran.def: Of or pertaining to the theology of Martin Luther (1483–1546) or his followers, or the Lutheran church.
A member of any of the Christian churches which identify with the theology of Martin Luther.

arrow.def: A projectile consisting of a shaft, a point and a tail with stabilizing fins that is shot from a bow.
To move swiftly and directly (like an arrow).

armor.def: A protective layer over a body, vehicle, or other object intended to deflect or diffuse damaging forces.

slash.def: To cut or attempt to cut
Used to note the sound or action of a slash.

fireball.def: A ball of fire, especially one associated with an explosion, or (fiction, mythology) thrown as a weapon.
To attack (someone or something) with balls of fire.

snowball.def: A ball of snow, usually one made in the hand and thrown for amusement in a snowball fight; also a larger ball of snow made by rolling a snowball around in snow that sticks to it and increases its diameter.
Of something with rapid growth, often uncontrolled. Compare snowball effect.
To rapidly grow out of proportion or control, from an initially smaller state.

monolith.def: A large, single block of stone which is a natural feature; or a block of stone or other similar material used in architecture and sculpture, especially one carved into a monument in ancient times.
To create (something) as, or convert (one or more things) into, a monolith.

rock.def: To pelt with rocks; to stone.

boulder.def: A large mass of stone detached from the surrounding land.

weird.def: Having an unusually strange character or behaviour.
To destine; doom; change by witchcraft or sorcery.

strange.def: Not normal; odd, unusual, surprising, out of the ordinary, often with a negative connotation.
Sex outside of one's current relationship.

ply.def: To bend; to fold; to mould; (figuratively) to adapt, to modify; to change (a person's) mind, to cause (a person) to submit.

plywood.def: Construction material supplied in sheets, and made of three or more layers of wood veneer glued together, laid up with alternating layers having their grain perpendicular to each other.
To fit or block up with plywood.

forest.def: A dense uncultivated tract of trees and undergrowth, larger than woods.
To cover an area with trees.

grove.def: To cultivate in groves; to grow naturally so as to form groves.

muse.def: Of a person: a source of inspiration.
To become lost in thought, to ponder.

crash.def: A sudden, intense, loud sound, as made for example by cymbals.
To collide with something destructively; to fall or come down violently.

rash.def: Acting too quickly without considering the consequences and risks; not careful; hasty.
Synonym of rashly (“in a rash manner; hastily or without due consideration”).

cash.def: Money in the form of notes or bills and coins, as opposed to checks, credit or electronic transactions.
To exchange (a check/cheque) for money in the form of notes/bills.

gash.def: To make a deep, long cut; to slash.
Of poor quality; makeshift; improvised; temporary; substituted.

dash.def: Any of the following symbols: ‒ (figure dash), – (en dash), — (em dash), or ― (horizontal bar).
To run quickly or for a short distance.

wash.def: The process or an instance of washing or being washed by water or other liquid.

hash.def: Food, especially meat and potatoes, chopped and mixed together.
To chop into small pieces, to make into a hash.

brash.def: Overly bold or self-assertive to the point of being insensitive, tactless or impudent; shameless.
A rash or eruption; a sudden or transient fit of sickness.

clash.def: A loud sound, like the crashing together of metal objects; a crash.

sash.def: A piece of cloth designed to be worn around the waist.

meal.def: Food that is prepared and eaten, usually at a specific time, and usually in a comparatively large quantity.
To yield or be plentiful in meal.

lunch.def: A light meal usually eaten around midday, notably when not as main meal of the day.

dinner.def: The main meal of the day, often eaten in the evening.
To eat a dinner; to dine.

kennel.def: A house or shelter for a dog.
To house or board a dog (or less commonly another animal).

kiss.def: To touch with the lips or press the lips against, usually to show love or affection or passion, or as part of a greeting.
A touch with the lips, usually to express love or affection, or as a greeting.

fraction.def: A part of a whole, especially a comparatively small part.
To divide or break into fractions.

consumption.def: The act of eating, drinking or using.

mega.def: A megararity (extremely rare bird for a certain region).

micro.def: Very small in scale or scope.

crook.def: A bend; turn; curve; curvature; a flexure.
To bend, or form into a hook.
Bad, unsatisfactory, not up to standard.

staff.def: A long, straight, thick wooden rod or stick, especially one used to assist in walking.
To supply (a business, volunteer organization, etc.) with employees or staff members.

kaj.def: A spirit of storm and wind;

cauliflower.def: Brassica oleracea var. botrytis, an annual variety of cabbage, of which the cluster of young flower stalks and buds is eaten as a vegetable.
To (cause to) swell up like a cauliflower ear.

countdown.def: A count backward in fixed units to the time of some event, especially the launch of a space vehicle.

gamble.def: To take a risk, with the potential of a positive outcome.

vodka.def: A clear distilled alcoholic liquor made from grain mash.

mania.def: Violent derangement of mind; madness; insanity.

telethon.def: A televised fundraising event encouraging viewers to make donations via telephone.

phone.def: A device for transmitting conversations and other sounds in real time across distances, now often a small portable unit also capable of running software etc.

net.def: A mesh of string, cord or rope.

Free from extraneous substances; pure; unadulterated; neat.

navel.def: The indentation or bump remaining in the abdomen of placental mammals where the umbilical cord was attached before birth.

side.def: A bounding straight edge of a two-dimensional shape.

To ally oneself, be in an alliance, usually with "with" or rarely "in with"

sloop.def: A single-masted sailboat with only one headsail.

mast.def: A non-judicial punishment ("NJP"); a disciplinary hearing under which a commanding officer studies and disposes of cases involving those under his command.
To supply and fit a mast to (a ship).

accustomed.def: Familiar with something through repeated experience; adapted to existing conditions. (of a person)

porthole.def: A gunport; an opening in the hull of a ship through which cannons are fired.

switch.def: A device to turn electric current on and off or direct its flow.
Pertaining to riding with the front and back feet swapped round compared to one's normal position.

To shift, or swing around, as a sail, boom, yard, etc., as in tacking.

requiem.def: A Mass (especially Catholic) to honor and remember a dead person.

daniel.def: A wise judge, like the biblical Daniel who ingeniously saved a woman from false accusations of adultery.

vegan.def: Not containing animal products (meat, eggs, milk, leather, etc) or inherently involving animal use.
A person who does not eat, drink or otherwise consume any animal products

vegetarian.def: A person who does not eat animal flesh, or, in some cases, use any animal products.
Of or relating to the type of diet eaten by vegetarians (in all senses).

ship.def: A water-borne vessel generally larger than a boat.

textile.def: Any material made of interlacing or matted fibres, including carpeting and geotextiles, woven or nonwoven.

peat.def: Soil formed of dead but not fully decayed plants found in bog areas, often burned as fuel.

visa.def: A permit to enter and leave a country, normally issued by the authorities of the country to be visited.

harp.def: A musical instrument consisting of a body and a curved neck, strung with strings of varying length that are stroked or plucked with the fingers and are vertical to the soundboard when viewed from the end of the body
To repeatedly mention a subject, especially so as to nag or complain.

splinter.def: A long, sharp fragment of material, often wood.
To come apart into long sharp fragments.

protagonist.def: The main character, or one of the main characters, in any story, such as a literary work or drama.

android.def: A robot that is designed to look and act like a human being (not necessarily a male one).

proctor.def: A person who supervises students as they take an examination, in the United States at the college/university level; often the department secretary, or a fellow/graduate student; an invigilator.
Pertaining to the Proctor test, a standardized test measuring soil moisture-density, especially for the requirements of construction projects.

birthday.def: The anniversary of the day on which someone is born.

privacy.def: The state of being secluded from the presence, sight, or knowledge of others.

pricing.def: The act of setting a price.

needle.def: Any slender, pointed object resembling a needle, such as a pointed crystal, a sharp pinnacle of rock, an obelisk, etc.

christmas.def: Sprigs of holly and other evergreen plants used as Christmas decorations; also (generally), any Christmas decorations.

serbian.def: Of or pertaining to Serbia, the Serbian people or their language.
A native or inhabitant of Serbia.

chop.def: A cut of meat, often containing a section of a rib.
To cut into pieces with short, vigorous cutting motions.

respective.def: Relating to particular persons or things, each to each; particular; own.

To store in a warehouse or similar.

wholesale.def: The sale of products, often in large quantities, to retailers or other merchants.
Of or relating to sale in large quantities, for resale.

apothecary.def: Synonym of pharmacist: a person who sells medicine, especially (historical) one who made and sold their own medicines in the medieval or early modern eras.

libertarian.def: One who advocates liberty, either generally or in relation to a specific issue.
Advocating liberty; also, having a relative tendency towards liberty.

pleasure.def: A state of being pleased or contented; gratification.
To give or afford pleasure to.

pennies.def: An unspecified, but very small amount of money.

scarecrow.def: An effigy, typically made of straw and dressed in old clothes, fixed to a pole in a field to deter birds from eating crops or seeds planted there.
To cause (a person, their body, etc.) to look awkward and stiff, like a scarecrow (noun sense 1).

secrete.def: To extract a substance from blood, sap, or similar to produce and emit waste for excretion or for the fulfilling of a physiological function.

bang.def: To make sudden loud noises, and often repeatedly, especially by exploding or hitting something.

banging.def: The action or sound of something that bangs.
Excellent, brilliant, very exciting, top, great.

mating.def: Fitting into or onto a corresponding part, as a matched plug and socket.

mate.def: A fellow, comrade, colleague, partner or someone with whom something is shared, e.g. shipmate, classmate.
To match, fit together without space between.

apron.def: An article of clothing worn over the front of the torso and/or legs for protection from spills; also historically worn by Freemasons and as part of women's fashion.
To cover with, or as if with, an apron.

acetone.def: A colourless, volatile, flammable liquid ketone, (CH₃)₂CO, used as a solvent.

belt.def: A band worn around the waist to hold clothing to one's body (usually pants), hold weapons (such as a gun or sword), or serve as a decorative piece of clothing.
To fasten a belt on; to encircle with a belt.

characteristic.def: Being a distinguishing feature of a person or thing.
A distinguishing feature of a person or thing, a part of mental or physical behavior.

waist.def: The part of the body between the pelvis and the stomach.

relate.def: To tell in a descriptive way.

banal.def: Common in a boring way, to the point of being predictable; containing nothing new or fresh.

accosted.def: Supported on both sides by other charges.

injure.def: To wound or cause physical harm to a living creature.

discharge.def: To accomplish or complete, as an obligation.
The act of expelling or letting go.

gunshot.def: The act of discharging a firearm.

walnut.def: A hardwood tree of the genus Juglans.
Having a dark brown colour, the colour of walnut wood.

bitch.def: A female dog or other canine, particularly a recent mother.
To behave or act as a bitch; especially, to complain excessively.

movie.def: A recorded sequence of images displayed on a screen at a rate sufficiently fast to create the appearance of motion; a film.

recording.def: The act of storing sound, video, etc., in a permanent medium.

center.def: The point in the interior of a circle that is equidistant from all points on the circumference.
Of, at, or related to a center.
To cause (an object) to occupy the center of an area.

attribute.def: A characteristic or quality of a thing.
To ascribe (something) to a given cause, reason etc.; to affix.

almond.def: The seed within the drupe of a small deciduous tree in family Rosaceae, Prunus amygdalus, considered a culinary nut.
Brownish, resembling the colour of an almond nut.

intersection.def: The junction of two (or more) paths, streets, highways, or other thoroughfares.

voltage.def: The difference in electrostatic potential between two points in space, especially between live and neutral conductors or the earth.

rust.def: The deteriorated state of iron or steel as a result of moisture and oxidation; it consists mostly of iron(III) oxide (ferric oxide) and iron(II) oxide (ferrous oxide).
To oxidize, especially of iron or steel.

rectangle.def: Any quadrilateral having opposing sides parallel and four right angles.

pair.def: Two alike or identical things taken together; often followed by of.
To group into one or more sets of two.

operation.def: The method by which a device performs its function.

aphasia.def: A partial or total loss of language skills due to brain damage. Usually, damage to the left perisylvian region, including Broca's area and Wernicke's area, causes aphasia.

transcendent.def: That which surpasses or is supereminent; something excellent.

nefarious.def: Sinful, villainous, criminal, or wicked, especially when noteworthy or notorious for such characteristics.

furtive.def: Of a thing: done with evasive or guilty secrecy.

phalanx.def: An ancient Greek and Macedonian military unit that consisted of several ranks and files (lines) of soldiers in close array with joined shields and long spears.

lemonade.def: A flavored beverage consisting of water, lemon, and sweetener, sometimes ice, served mainly as a refreshment.

algebra.def: Elementary algebra: A system for representing and manipulating unknown quantities (variables) in equations.

sine.def: In a right triangle, the ratio of the length of the side opposite an angle to the length of the hypotenuse.

tangent.def: A straight line touching a curve at a single point without crossing it there.
Touching a curve at a single point but not crossing it at that point.

mail.def: To send (a letter, parcel, etc.) through the mail.

effigy.def: A dummy or other crude representation of a person, group or object that is hated.

bagel.def: A toroidal bread roll that is boiled before it is baked.

standoff.def: A device which maintains a fixed distance between two objects, especially between a surface and a sign or electrical wiring.
For use at a distance sufficient from the target to allow defensive fire to be evaded.

parachute.def: A device, generally constructed from fabric, that is designed to employ air resistance to control the fall of an object or person, causing them to float instead of falling.
To jump, fall, descend, etc. using such a device.

flue.def: A pipe or duct that carries gaseous combustion products away from the point of combustion (such as a furnace).

furnace.def: An industrial heating device, such as for smelting metal or firing ceramics.

heat.def: To cause an increase in temperature of (an object or space); to cause to become hot (often with "up").

factory.def: A building or other place where manufacturing takes place.
Having come from the factory in the state it is currently in; original, stock.

esoteric.def: Intended for or likely to be understood by only a small number of people with a specialized knowledge or interest, or an enlightened inner circle.
An esoteric doctrine or treatise; esoteric philosophy.

gasoline.def: A flammable liquid consisting of a mixture of refined petroleum hydrocarbons, mainly used as a motor fuel; petrol.

combustion.def: The act or process of burning.
