hernia.def: A disorder in which a part of the body protrudes abnormally through a tear or opening in an adjacent part, especially of the abdomen.

snowman.def: A humanoid figure made with large snowballs stacked on each other. Human traits like a face and arms may be fashioned with sticks (arms), a carrot (nose), and stones or coal (eyes, mouth).

aching.def: That aches; continuously painful; that causes pain.
The feeling of an ache; a dull pain.

frown.def: A wrinkling of the forehead with the eyebrows brought together, typically indicating displeasure, severity, or concentration.
To have a frown on one's face.

success.def: The achievement of one's aim or goal.

cant.def: An argot, the jargon of a particular class or subgroup.
To speak with the jargon of a class or subgroup.

wont.def: One's habitual way of doing things; custom, habit, practice.
Accustomed or used (to or with a thing), accustomed or apt (to do something).
To make (someone) used to; to accustom.

petrol.def: A fluid consisting of a mixture of refined petroleum hydrocarbons, primarily consisting of octane, commonly used as a motor fuel.
To fill or supply (a vehicle, etc.) with petrol.

heir.def: Someone who inherits, or is designated to inherit, the property of another.

yore.def: In time long past; long ago.

yaw.def: The rotation of an aircraft, ship, or missile about its vertical axis so as to cause the longitudinal axis of the aircraft, ship, or missile to deviate from the flight line or heading in its horizontal plane.
To turn about the vertical axis while maintaining course.

yawn.def: To open the mouth widely and take a long, rather deep breath, often because one is tired or bored, and sometimes accompanied by pandiculation.
The action of yawning; opening the mouth widely and taking a long, rather deep breath, often because one is tired or bored.

jaw.def: One of the bones, usually bearing teeth, which form the framework of the mouth.
To assail or abuse by scolding.

paw.def: The soft foot of a mammal or other animal, generally a quadruped, that has claws or nails; comparable to a human hand or foot.
Of an animal, to touch (something) with a paw.

pause.def: To take a temporary rest, take a break for a short period after an effort.
A temporary stop or rest; an intermission of action; interruption; suspension; cessation.

gauze.def: A thin fabric with a loose, open weave.
To apply a dressing of gauze; to cover with gauze.

haunt.def: To inhabit or to visit frequently (most often used in reference to ghosts).
A place at which one is regularly found; a habitation or hangout.

main.def: Of chief or leading importance; prime, principal.
Exceedingly, extremely, greatly, mightily, very, very much.
Ellipsis of mainline (“to inject (a drug) directly into a vein”).

mane.def: Longer hair growth on back of neck of an animal, especially a horse or lion.

hymn.def: A song of praise or worship, especially a religious one.

stalk.def: The stem or main axis of a plant.
To approach slowly and quietly in order not to be discovered when getting closer.

purge.def: To clean thoroughly; to rid of impurities; to cleanse.
An act or instance of purging.

service.def: An act of being of assistance to someone.

cruise.def: A sea or lake voyage, especially one taken for pleasure.
To sail about, especially for pleasure.

reliable.def: Suitable or fit to be relied on; worthy of dependence, reliance or trust; dependable, trustworthy
Something or someone reliable or dependable

trust.def: Confidence in or reliance on some person or quality.
To place confidence in, to rely on, to confide in.

gauntlet.def: Protective armor for the hands, formerly thrown down as a challenge to combat.

jenny.def: A device for spinning thread from fiber onto multiple spindles (also called spinning jenny).
To wind finished lace onto cards ready for sale.

simian.def: Of or pertaining to apes and monkeys.
An ape or monkey, especially an anthropoid (infraorder Simiiformes).

immature.def: Occurring before the proper time; untimely, premature (especially of death).
An immature member of a species.

pentagon.def: A polygon with five sides and five angles.

wort.def: Now chiefly as the second element in the names of plants: a plant used for food or medicine.

pineapple.def: A tropical plant, Ananas comosus, native to South America, having thirty or more long, spined and pointed leaves surrounding a thick stem.

yam.def: Any climbing vine of the genus Dioscorea in the Eastern and Western hemispheres, usually cultivated.

maize.def: Corn; a type of grain of the species Zea mays.

tobacco.def: Any plant of the genus Nicotiana.
To indulge in tobacco; to smoke.

caucus.def: A usually preliminary meeting of party members to nominate candidates for public office or delegates to be sent to a nominating convention, or to confer regarding policy.
To meet and participate in a caucus.

hawk.def: A diurnal predatory bird of the family Accipitridae, smaller than an eagle.

roman.def: One of the main three types used for the Latin alphabet (the others being italics and blackletter), in which the ascenders are mostly straight.

pope.def: An honorary title of the Roman Catholic bishop of Rome as father and head of his church, a sovereign of the Vatican city state.
To act as or like a pope.

identify.def: To establish the identity of someone or something.

undermine.def: To dig underneath (something), to make a passage for destructive or military purposes; to sap.

exile.def: The state of being banished from one's home or country.
To send (someone or something) into exile.

double.def: Made up of two matching or complementary elements.
Twice the number, amount, size, etc.

czar.def: An appointed official tasked to regulate or oversee a specific area.

tsar.def: An emperor of Russia (1547 to 1917) and of some South Slavic states.

ghetto.def: An (often walled) area of a city in which Jews are concentrated by force and law. (Used particularly of areas in medieval Italy and in Nazi-controlled Europe.)
Of or relating to a ghetto or to ghettos in general.
To confine (a specified group of people) to a ghetto.

sunroof.def: A fixed or operable opening in a vehicle roof (car or truck) which allows fresh air and/or light to enter the passenger compartment. A sunroof may include a transparent or opaque panel and may be manually operated or power driven.

apricot.def: A round sweet and juicy stone fruit, resembling peach or plum in taste, with a yellow-orange flesh, lightly fuzzy skin and a large seed inside.
Of a pale yellowish-orange colour, like that of an apricot.

souvenir.def: An item of sentimental value, that is given or kept to remember an event or location.
To take (something) as a souvenir, especially illicitly, for example during wartime.

magazine.def: A nonacademic, periodical publication which consists of articles by multiple writers on some broad topic or theme.

mug.def: A large cup for beverages, usually having a handle and used without a saucer.

seine.def: A long net having floats attached at the top and sinkers (weights) at the bottom, used in shallow water for catching fish.
To use a seine, to fish with a seine.

cosy.def: Affording comfort and warmth; snug; social and comfortable.
A padded or knit covering put on an item to keep it warm, especially a teapot or egg.

cartouche.def: An ornamental figure, often on an oval shield.

formaldehyde.def: The simplest aldehyde, HCHO, a colourless gas that has many industrial applications; it dissolves in water to give formol (10%) and formalin.

pumice.def: A light, porous type of pyroclastic igneous rock, formed during explosive volcanic eruptions when liquid lava is ejected into water or air as a froth containing masses of gas bubbles, which are frozen into the rock as the lava solidifies.
To abrade or roughen with pumice.

mope.def: To carry oneself in a depressed, lackadaisical manner; to give oneself up to low spirits; to pout, sulk.

pestilence.def: Any epidemic disease that is highly contagious, infectious, virulent and devastating.

mange.def: A skin disease of nonhuman mammals caused by parasitic mites (Sarcoptes spp., Demodecidae spp.).

erudite.def: Learned, scholarly, with emphasis on knowledge gained from books.

moat.def: A deep, wide defensive ditch, normally filled with water, surrounding a fortified habitation.

smite.def: A heavy strike with a weapon, tool, or the hand.

prestige.def: The quality of how good the reputation of something or someone is, how favourably something or someone is regarded.
Regarded as relatively prestigious; often, considered the standard language or language variety, or a part of such a variety.
To start over at an earlier point in a video game with some type of bonus or reward.

brine.def: Salt water; water saturated or strongly impregnated with salt; a salt-and-water solution for pickling.
To preserve food in a salt solution.

prawn.def: A crustacean of the suborder Dendrobranchiata.

shrimp.def: Any of many swimming, often edible, crustaceans, chiefly of the infraorder Caridea or the suborder Dendrobranchiata, with slender legs, long whiskers and a long abdomen.

amaze.def: To fill (someone) with surprise and wonder; to astonish, to astound, to surprise.
Amazement, astonishment; (countable) an instance of this.

amazing.def: Causing wonder and amazement; very surprising.

tod.def: To weigh; to yield in tods.

maggot.def: A soft, legless larva of a fly or other dipteran insect, that often eats decomposing organic matter.

peep.def: A short, soft, high-pitched sound, as made by a baby bird.
To make a soft, shrill noise like a baby bird.

cot.def: A simple bed, especially one for portable or temporary purposes.

busy.def: Crowded with business or activities; having a great deal going on.
To make somebody busy or active; to occupy.

pretty.def: Pleasant to the sight or other senses; attractive, especially of women or children.
Somewhat, fairly, quite; sometimes also (by meiosis) very.
A pretty person; a term of address to a pretty person.

slip.def: To lose one’s traction on a slippery surface; to slide due to a lack of friction.
An act or instance of slipping.

ink.def: A pigment (or dye)-based fluid used for writing, printing etc.
To apply ink to; to cover or smear with ink.

peculiar.def: Out of the ordinary; odd; strange; unusual.
That which is peculiar; a sole or exclusive property; a prerogative; a characteristic.

explore.def: To seek for something or after someone.
An exploration; a tour of a place to see what it is like.

manifold.def: Various in kind, quality, or manifestation; diverse.
A copy made by the manifold writing process.

include.def: To bring into a group, class, set, or total as a (new) part or member.
A piece of source code or other content that is dynamically retrieved for inclusion in another item.

raw.def: An unprocessed sugar; a batch of such.

evergreen.def: Of plants, especially trees, that do not shed their leaves seasonally.
A shrub or tree that does not shed its leaves or needles seasonally.
To extend the term of a patent beyond the normal legal limit, usually through repeated small modifications.

canyon.def: A valley, especially a long, narrow, steep valley, cut in rock by a river.
Of water, liquid, or another substance, to flow in or into a canyon.

doppelganger.def: A ghostly double of a living person, especially one that haunts such a person.

poltergeist.def: An unseen ghost which makes noises and causes disruption, especially by causing physical objects to move or fly about.

ghost.def: A disembodied soul; a soul or spirit of a deceased person; a spirit appearing after death.
In the form be ghost: not present or involved; absent, gone.
Of a disembodied soul: to appear (somewhere or to someone) in the form of an apparition; to haunt.

christendom.def: The Christian world; Christ's Church on Earth.

puritan.def: Acting or behaving according to the Puritan morals (e.g. propagating modesty), especially with regard to pleasure, nudity and sex; ascetic.

pretext.def: A false, contrived, or assumed purpose or reason; a pretense.
To employ a pretext, which involves using a false or contrived purpose for soliciting the gain of something else.

subtext.def: The implicit meaning of a text, often a literary one, or a speech or dialogue.
To create or use a subtext.

wicked.def: Evil or mischievous by nature; morally reprehensible.
To a superlative extent, very, extremely

horrid.def: Terribly; horridly; to an extreme extent.

contribute.def: To give something that is or becomes part of a larger whole.

saxophone.def: A single-reed instrument musical instrument of the woodwind family, usually made of brass and with a distinctive loop bringing the bell upwards.

honeycomb.def: Something resembling honeycomb (noun sense 1) in having numerous cells or small holes.
To riddle (something) with small holes, especially in a pattern resembling a honeycomb (noun sense 1); also, to cause (something) to become hollow or weakened in this way.

blueberry.def: An edible round berry, belonging to the cowberry group (Vaccinium sect. Cyanococcus), with flared crowns at the end, that turns blue on ripening.
To gather or forage for blueberries.

cornflakes.def: A breakfast cereal made from toasted flakes of maize.

bes.def: A bronze coin of the Roman Republic, worth two thirds of an as.

poker.def: A metal rod, generally of wrought iron, for adjusting the burning logs or coals in a fire; a firestick.
To poke with a utensil such as a poker or needle.

decompose.def: To separate or break down (something) into its components.

compose.def: To make something by merging parts.

compress.def: To make smaller; to press or squeeze together, or to make something occupy a smaller space or volume.
A multiply folded piece of cloth, a pouch of ice, etc., used to apply to a patient's skin, cover the dressing of wounds, and placed with the aid of a bandage to apply pressure on an injury.

lore.def: All the facts and traditions about a particular subject that have been accumulated over time through education or experience.

horsepower.def: Power derived from the motion of a horse.

horseshoe.def: The U-shaped shoe of a horse, now typically made of metal; by extension, a representation of this used to play the game horseshoes, hung as a luck charm, etc.

racetrack.def: A course over which any type of races are run.

speedway.def: A form of motorcycle racing on flat (without camber) oval dirt tracks using motorcycles with neither brakes nor gears.

turf.def: A layer of earth covered with grass; sod.
To cover with turf; to create a lawn by laying turfs.

clitoris.def: A sensitive elongated erectile sex organ at the anterior part of the vulva in female humans and other mammals.

bury.def: To ritualistically inter in a grave or tomb.

snooker.def: A cue sport, popular in the UK and other Commonwealth of Nations countries.
To play the game of snooker.

billiards.def: A two-player cue sport played with two cue balls and one red ball, on a snooker sized table.

pool.def: A small and rather deep area of (usually) fresh water, as one supplied by a spring, or occurring in the course of a stream or river; a reservoir for water.

pirate.def: A criminal who plunders at sea; commonly attacking merchant vessels, though often pillaging port towns.
To appropriate by piracy; to plunder at sea.
Illegally imitated or reproduced, said of a trademarked product or copyrighted work, or of the counterfeit itself.

buccaneer.def: Any of a group of seamen who cruised on their own account on the Spanish Main and in the Pacific in the 17th century, who were similar to pirates but did not prey on ships of their own nation.
To engage in piracy against any but one's own nation's ships.

mourn.def: To express sadness or sorrow for; to grieve over (especially a death).

autopsy.def: A dissection performed on a cadaver to find possible cause(s) of death.

great.def: A person of major significance, accomplishment or acclaim.
Very well (in a very satisfactory manner).

grate.def: A horizontal metal grill through which liquid, ash, or small objects can fall, while larger objects cannot.
To furnish with grates; to protect with a grating or crossbars.

grater.def: a tool with which one grates, especially foods such as cheese, to facilitate getting small particles or shreds off a solid lump

greater.def: Of two (or, rarely, more than two) things: the larger in size (bigger), in value, in importance etc.

more.def: To a greater degree or extent.

kitsch.def: Art, decorative objects, and other forms of representation of questionable artistic or aesthetic value; a representation that is excessively sentimental, overdone, or vulgar.
Of art and decor: of questionable aesthetic value; excessively sentimental, overdone or vulgar.

nude.def: Without clothing or other covering of the skin; without clothing on the genitals or female nipples.
A painting, sculpture, photograph or other artwork or mass-media-reproduced image depicting one or more human figure(s) in a state of near or total undress.

putt.def: The act of tapping a golf ball lightly on a putting green.
To lightly strike a golf ball with a putter.

log.def: The trunk of a dead tree, cleared of branches.

pachinko.def: A mechanical ball-dropping game similar to pinball, popular in Japan.
To tumble down through a series of obstacles.

lug.def: The act of hauling or dragging.
To haul or drag along (especially something heavy); to carry; to pull.

luggage.def: The bags and other containers that hold a traveller's belongings.

baggage.def: Portable cases, large bags, and similar equipment for manually carrying, pushing, or pulling personal items while traveling

special.def: Distinguished by a unique, particular, or unusual quality.
A reduction in consumer cost (usually for a limited time) for items or services rendered; the thing thus sold.

recent.def: Having happened a short while ago.
A recently viewed or accessed item.

noose.def: An adjustable loop of rope, such as the one placed around the neck in hangings, or the one at the end of a lasso.
To tie or catch in a noose; to entrap or ensnare.

chore.def: A task, especially a regularly needed task for the upkeep of a home or similar, such as cleaning or preparing meals.

whore.def: Synonym of prostitute: a person (especially a woman) who offers sexual services for payment.

jesus.def: To subject to (excessive) Christian proselytizing, preaching, or moralizing.

sumo.def: A stylised Japanese form of wrestling in which a wrestler loses if he is forced from the ring, or if any part of his body except the soles of his feet touches the ground.

couch.def: An item of furniture, often upholstered, for the comfortable seating of more than one person; a sofa.
To lie down; to recline (upon a couch or other place of repose).

lounge.def: To relax; to spend time lazily; to stand, sit, or recline, in an indolent manner.
A place where one can lounge; an area, establishment, house etc. where loungers gather and where one can relax and be at ease.

manatee.def: Any of several plant-eating marine mammals, of the genus Trichechus, found in tropical regions.

annual.def: An annual publication; a book, periodical, journal, report, comic book, yearbook, etc., which is published serially once a year, which may or may not be in addition to regular weekly or monthly publication.

millennial.def: Thousand-year-old; also (by extension, loosely) thousands of years old.
A thousandth anniversary; also, a celebration of such an anniversary.

carburetor.def: A device in an internal combustion engine where fuel is vaporized and mixed with air prior to ignition.

creole.def: A language formed from two or more languages which has developed from a pidgin to become a first language.
Pertaining to or characteristic of someone who is a Creole.

meek.def: Humble, non-boastful, modest, meager, or self-effacing.

eerie.def: Inspiring fear, especially in a mysterious or shadowy way; strange, weird.

earthworm.def: A worm that lives in the ground.

rex.def: A king, particularly in ancient Rome.
To breed (an animal) to have this kind of hair.

nix.def: To make something become nothing; to reject or cancel.

less.def: Used for constructing syntactic diminutive comparatives of adjectives and adverbs.

least.def: Chiefly preceded by the: superlative form of little: most little.
In a degree below all others; in the lowest or smallest degree.
Preceded by the: superlative form of little: most little; the lowest-ranking or most insignificant person or (sometimes) group of people.

manic.def: Characterized by mania or craziness; wicked.

leaf.def: The usually green and flat organ that represents the most prominent feature of most vegetative plants.
To produce leaves; put forth foliage.

coyote.def: Canis latrans, a species of canine native to North America.
To prospect for gold by manually digging holes into overlying earth, as into a hillside.

fawn.def: To give birth to a fawn.

jackrabbit.def: Any of several large North American hares of the genus Lepus.
To make a sudden, rapid movement

skunk.def: To defeat so badly as to prevent any opposing points.

rowing.def: The action of the verb to row.

ska.def: A style of Jamaican dance music originating in the late 1950s, combining elements of Caribbean calypso and mento with American jazz and rhythm and blues; it was the precursor to rocksteady and reggae.

pudding.def: Any of various dishes, sweet or savoury, prepared by boiling or steaming, or from batter.

thief.def: One who carries out a theft.

row.def: A line of objects, often regularly spaced, such as seats in a theatre, vegetable plants in a garden, etc.
To propel (a boat or other craft) over water using oars.

nutrition.def: The organic process by which an organism assimilates food and uses it for growth and maintenance.

bavarian.def: A type of custard-like food, made with fruit.
Of, from or relating to the state of Bavaria, Germany.

timber.def: Trees in a forest regarded as a source of wood.

lumber.def: Wood sawn into planks or otherwise prepared for sale or use, especially as a building material.
To move clumsily and heavily; to move slowly.

bengali.def: Of, from or pertaining to Bengal or the Bengalis.
A person from Bengal or of Bengali descent.

lumbar.def: Related to the lower back or loin, specifically the five vertebrae between the rib cage and the pelvis.

gujarati.def: Of, from, or pertaining to Gujarat, or the Gujarati people.

hopi.def: A member of a particular tribe of North American natives.

luo.def: An ethnic group in southern Sudan, Kenya, and neighboring countries.

mohawk.def: A member of an indigenous people of North America originally from the Mohawk Valley in upstate New York to southern Quebec and eastern Ontario, the easternmost of the Iroquois Five Nations.

punjabi.def: Of, pertaining to, descended from the people or culture of the Punjab, or written in the Punjabi language.
The main language spoken in the Punjab region, in eastern Pakistan and Northern India.

shona.def: A member of the Bantu tribes who speak Shona.

tamil.def: Of or pertaining to the Tamil people, culture, or language.
A person who originates from Tamil Nadu, India or Sri Lanka or has Tamil origins.

urdu.def: Of or relating to the Urdu language.

dumpling.def: A ball of dough that is cooked and may have a filling and/or additional ingredients in the dough.

antenna.def: An appendage used for sensing on the head of an insect, crab, or other animal.

appendix.def: Something attached to something else; an attachment or accompaniment.

trunk.def: To lop off; to curtail; to truncate.

bacterium.def: A single-celled organism with cell walls but no nucleus or organelles.

bureau.def: An administrative unit of government; office.

beau.def: A man with a reputation for fine dress and etiquette; a dandy or fop.
To act as a beau (towards); to court or woo.

corpus.def: A collection of written or spoken texts.

batter.def: To hit or strike violently and repeatedly.
A beaten mixture of flour and liquid (usually egg and milk), used for baking (e.g. pancakes, cake, or Yorkshire pudding) or to coat food (e.g. fish) prior to frying.

aerial.def: Living or taking place in the air.
A rod, wire, or other structure for receiving or transmitting radio, television signals etc.

method.def: A process by which a task is completed; a way of doing something (followed by the adposition of, to or for before the purpose of the process).

scenario.def: An outline or model of an expected or supposed sequence of events.

shared.def: Used by multiple entities or for multiple purposes or in multiple ways.

truck.def: A small wheel or roller, specifically the wheel of a gun carriage.

label.def: A small ticket or sign giving information about something to which it is attached or intended to be attached.
To put a label (a ticket or sign) on (something).

buyer.def: A person who makes one or more purchases.

local.def: From or in a nearby location.
A person who lives in or near a given place.
In the local area; within a city, state, country, etc.

flour.def: Powder obtained by grinding or milling cereal grains, especially wheat, or other foodstuffs such as soybeans and potatoes, and used to bake bread, cakes, and pastry.
To apply flour to something; to cover with flour.

mango.def: A tropical Asian fruit tree, Mangifera indica.

curry.def: One of a family of dishes originating from Indian cuisine, flavored by a spiced sauce.
To cook or season with curry powder.

gab.def: To jest; to tell lies in jest; exaggerate; lie.

harpsichord.def: A stringed musical instrument with a keyboard, the mechanical precusor to the fortepiano, in which each key causes a plectrum to pluck a corresponding tuned string, producing a bright, sharp tone similar to that of a harp.

defunct.def: No longer in use or active, nor expected to be again.

loo.def: A lavatory: a room used for urination and defecation.
To urge on with cries of loo or (figuratively) by other shouting or outcry.

follower.def: One who follows, comes after another.

rope.def: Thick strings, yarn, monofilaments, metal wires, or strands of other cordage that are twisted together to form a stronger line.

killer.def: One who or that which kills.

crapper.def: A chamber pot or toilet, particularly (dated) a flush toilet by Thomas Crapper.

system.def: A group or set of related things that operate together as a complex whole.

nebula.def: A cloud in outer space consisting of gas or dust (e.g. a cloud formed after a star explodes).

hurricane.def: A severe tropical cyclone; an intense storm rotating around a central eye.
To be violent, with winds of 119 km/h (74 miles per hour) or greater, usually accompanied by rain, lightning, and thunder.

typhoon.def: A severe tropical cyclone; an intense, rotating storm.

cyclone.def: Any weather phenomenon consisting of a system of winds rotating around a centre of low atmospheric pressure; a low pressure system.
To separate using a cyclone separator.

monsoon.def: Any of a number of winds associated with regions where most rain falls during a particular season.

alfredo.def: The sauce made from butter and Parmesan cheese used in dishes such as fettuccine Alfredo.

lust.def: A feeling of strong desire, especially such a feeling driven by sexual arousal.
To look at or watch with a strong desire, especially of a sexual nature.

glean.def: To collect (fruit, grain, or other produce) from a field, an orchard, etc., after the main gathering or harvest.
A collection of something made by gleaning.

tarantula.def: Any of the large, hairy New World spiders comprising the family Theraphosidae.

trucker.def: One who has done something offensive; a deceitful, dishonest, or disreputable person; a deceiver; a cheat.
Dishonest; resulting from or inspired by dishonesty.

criterion.def: A standard, test, or requirement by which individual things or people may be compared and judged; a gauge.

curriculum.def: The set of courses, coursework, and content offered at a school or university.

eater.def: A person or animal who eats.

knocker.def: A device, usually hinged with a striking plate, used for knocking on a door.

argue.def: To show grounds for concluding (that); to indicate, imply.

diagnosis.def: The process of, or an instance of, identification of the nature and cause of a medical condition or illness.

focus.def: A point at which reflected or refracted rays of light converge.
To cause (rays of light, etc) to converge at a single point.

fungus.def: Any member of the kingdom Fungi; a eukaryotic organism typically having chitin cell walls but no chlorophyll or plastids. Fungi may be unicellular or multicellular.

hypothesis.def: A tentative conjecture explaining an observation, phenomenon or scientific problem and that can be tested by further observation, investigation, or experimentation.

medium.def: The material of the surrounding environment, e.g. solid, liquid, gas, vacuum, or a specific substance such as a solvent.

oasis.def: A spring of fresh water, surrounded by a fertile region of vegetation, in a desert.

phenomenon.def: A thing or being, event or process, perceptible through senses; or a fact or occurrence thereof.

series.def: A number of things that follow on one after the other or are connected one after the other.

stimulus.def: An external phenomenon that has an influence on a system, by triggering or modifying an internal phenomenon; for example, a spur or incentive that drives a person to take action or change behaviour.

synthesis.def: The formation of something complex or coherent by combining simpler things.

synopsis.def: A brief summary of the major points of a written work, either as prose or as a table; an abridgment or condensation of a work.

tableau.def: A striking and vivid representation or scene; a picture.

thesis.def: Senses relating to logic, rhetoric, etc.

vita.def: A hagiography; a biography of a saint.

confrontation.def: The act of confronting or challenging another, especially face to face.

sum.def: A quantity obtained by addition or aggregation.

torso.def: The main part of the (human) body that extends from the neck to the groin, excluding the head and limbs.

shortage.def: A lack or deficiency; an insufficient amount.

debate.def: To participate in a debate; to dispute, argue, especially in a public arena.
An argument, or discussion, usually in an ordered or formal setting, often with more than two people, generally ending with a vote or other decision.

participate.def: To join in, to take part, to involve oneself (in something).

opus.def: A work of music or set of works with a specified rank in an ordering of a composer's complete published works.

breeze.def: To move casually, in a carefree manner.

pall.def: To cloak or cover with, or as if with, a pall.

pas.def: The right of going foremost; precedence.

peal.def: A loud sound, or a succession of loud sounds, as of bells, thunder, cannon, shouts, laughter, of a multitude, etc.
To sound with a peal or peals.

pelvic.def: Of, pertaining to, or in the region of, the pelvis

pep.def: To inject with energy and enthusiasm.

pew.def: One of the long benches in a church, seating several persons, usually fixed to the floor and facing the chancel.

photon.def: The quantum of light and other electromagnetic energy, regarded as a discrete particle having zero rest mass, no electric charge, and an indefinitely long lifetime. It is a gauge boson.

playa.def: A level area which habitually fills with water that evaporates entirely.

plumb.def: A little mass of lead, or the like, attached to a line, and used by builders, etc., to indicate a vertical direction.
Truly vertical, as indicated by a plumb line.

poi.def: The traditional staple food of Hawaii, made by baking and pounding the kalo (or taro) root, and reducing it to a thin paste, which is allowed to ferment.

pomp.def: Show of magnificence; parade; display; power.

ponce.def: A man living off another's earnings, especially a woman's.

popper.def: One who or that which pops.

prig.def: A deliberately superior person; a person who demonstrates an exaggerated conformity or propriety, especially in an irritatingly arrogant or smug manner.

prim.def: Of a person, their manner or appearance: Formal and precise; stiffly decorous.

pueblo.def: A community in Spain or Spanish America, especially one of Pueblo Indians living in a stone or adobe multi-storey building.

puffin.def: The young of the Manx shearwater (Puffinus puffinus), especially eaten as food.

pug.def: Senses relating to someone or something small.
To track (an animal) by following pawprints; also (by extension) to track (a person) by following footprints.

punter.def: One who rows or poles a punt (pontoon).

quahog.def: An edible clam with a hard shell found along the Atlantic Coast of North America, from species Mercenaria mercenaria, formerly Venus mercenaria.

quasar.def: An extragalactic object, starlike in appearance, that is among the most luminous and (putatively) the most distant objects in the universe.

quirt.def: A rawhide whip plaited with two thongs of buffalo hide.

realty.def: Real estate; a piece of real property; land.

ream.def: Cream; also, the creamlike froth on ale or other liquor; froth or foam in general.

recuse.def: To reject or repudiate (an authority, a person, a court judgment, etc.).

remit.def: To transmit or send (e.g. money in payment); to supply.
Terms of reference; set of responsibilities; scope.

rep.def: To represent; to act as a representative for.

rick.def: Straw, hay etc. stored in a stack for winter fodder, commonly protected with thatch.
To heap up (hay, etc.) in ricks.

rimmer.def: An implement for cutting, trimming, or ornamenting the rim of anything, as the edges of pies, etc.

romano.def: a hard, sharp cheese served grated as a garnish

rondo.def: A musical composition, commonly of a lively, cheerful character, in which the first strain recurs after each of the other strains.

rotor.def: A rotating part of a mechanical device; for example, in an electric motor, generator, alternator, or pump.

rube.def: A person of rural heritage; a yokel.

ruff.def: A circular frill or ruffle on a garment, especially a starched, fluted frill at the neck in Elizabethan and Jacobean England (1560s–1620s).
To shape (fabric, etc.) into a ruff; to adorn (a garment, etc.) with a ruff.

rumpus.def: A noisy, sometimes violent disturbance; noise and confusion; a noisy quarrel or brawl.
To cause a noisy disturbance or commotion.

rune.def: A letter, or character, used in the written language of various ancient Germanic peoples, especially the Scandinavians and the Anglo-Saxons.
To compose or perform poetry or songs.

rut.def: Sexual desire in any of many mammals, often specific to mating season.
To be in the annual rut or mating season.

ruth.def: Sorrow for the misery of another; pity, compassion; mercy.

sadist.def: One who derives pleasure through cruelty or pain to others.

sage.def: A very wise person or spiritual teacher; someone of gravity and wisdom, especially, a teacher venerable for years, and of sound judgment and prudence; a grave or stoic philosopher.
The act of using the word or option sage in the email field or a checkbox of an imageboard when posting a reply.

samba.def: A Brazilian ballroom dance or dance style.

saran.def: A plastic resin used to make packaging films.

scat.def: To sing an improvised melodic solo using nonsense syllables, often onomatopoeic or imitative of musical instruments.

septic.def: A substance that causes sepsis or putrefaction.

servo.def: To control by means of servocontrol

shad.def: Any one of several species of food fishes that make up the genus Alosa in the family Clupeidae, to which the herrings also belong; river herring.

shaw.def: A thicket; a small wood or grove.

shill.def: A person paid to endorse a product while pretending to be impartial.
To promote or endorse in return for payment, especially dishonestly; sometimes extended sarcastically even to those not paid but strongly biased in favor.

shim.def: To fit one or more shims to a piece of machinery or other assembly; to adjust (something) by using shims.

shiv.def: A knife, especially a makeshift one fashioned from something not normally used as a weapon (like a plastic spoon or a toothbrush).

shoji.def: A door or partition consisting of a wooden frame covered in rice paper, used in traditional Japanese architecture.

shunt.def: To cause to move (suddenly), as by pushing or shoving; to give a (sudden) start to.
An act of moving (suddenly), as due to a push or shove.

silt.def: Mud or fine earth deposited from running or standing water.
To clog or fill with silt.

sima.def: The upturned edge of a roof which acts as a gutter; a cyma.

sire.def: A lord, master, or other person in authority, most commonly used vocatively: formerly in speaking to elders and superiors, later only when addressing a sovereign.

skeet.def: A form of trapshooting using clay targets to simulate birds in flight.

slurry.def: Any flowable suspension of small particles in liquid.
To make a slurry (of some material).

snell.def: Quick, smart; sharp, active, brisk or nimble; lively.
A short line of horsehair, gut, monofilament, etc., by which a fishhook or lure is attached to a longer (and usually heavier) line.
To tie a hook to the end of a fishing line with a snell knot.

sod.def: The stratum of the surface of the soil which is filled with the roots of grass, or any portion of that surface; turf; sward.

soma.def: The whole axial portion of an animal, including the head, neck, trunk, and tail.

sop.def: To steep or dip in any liquid.

sora.def: A rail (Porzana carolina) bird of North, Central, and northern South America.

sou.def: An old French copper coin equal to one twentieth of a livre or twelve deniers; one sou is to the livre as one shilling is to the pound.

soy.def: A common East Asian liquid sauce, made by subjecting boiled beans to long fermentation and then long digestion in salt and water.
Characteristic of a soy boy; weak, unmasculine, etc.
Synonym of soy out (“to act in the manner of a soy boy”).

spitz.def: Any of several Nordic breeds of dog such as the Pomeranian or Samoyed.

staph.def: Staphylococcus bacteria and the infection it causes.

stasis.def: A slackening or arrest of the blood current, due not to a lessening of the heart’s beat, but to some abnormal resistance of the capillary walls.

stooge.def: One who knowingly allows himself or herself to be used for another's profit; a dupe.
To act as a straight man.

swami.def: A Hindu ascetic or religious teacher.

synod.def: An ecclesiastic council or meeting to consult on church matters.

tad.def: A small amount; a little bit.

talkie.def: A movie with sound, as opposed to a silent film.

taster.def: An object in which, or by which, food or drink is tasted, such as a small cup.

telex.def: To send a message over a telex network.

tenner.def: A monetary note (bill) whose face value is ten basic units of currency. Originally, a ten-shilling (half pound) note.

tibia.def: The inner and usually the larger of the two bones of the leg or hind limb below the knee, the shinbone.

tic.def: A sudden, nonrhythmic motor movement or vocalization.
To exhibit a tic; to undergo a sudden, semi-voluntary muscle movement.

tine.def: A spike or point on an implement or tool, especially a prong of a fork or a tooth of a comb.
To kindle; to set on fire.

tipper.def: Someone who tips; someone who gives a gratuity.

toby.def: A drinking mug, in the shape of a human head with a hat atop; a Toby jug.

tome.def: One in a series of volumes.

tony.def: Any of the statuettes awarded by the American Theatre Wing.

torah.def: A specially written scroll containing the five books of Moses, such as those used in religious services.

tory.def: A member or supporter of the Conservative Party, which evolved from Royalist politicians; historically associated with upholding the rights of the monarchy and the privileges of the established Church.
Of or belonging to the Tory Party or the Conservative Party.

trawl.def: A net or dragnet used for trawling.
To take (fish or other marine animals) with a trawl.

tuff.def: A light porous rock, now especially a rock composed of compacted volcanic ash varying in size from fine sand to coarse gravel.

tulle.def: A kind of silk lace or light netting, used for clothing, veils, etc.

vail.def: To lower, let fall; to allow or cause to sink.

vamp.def: The top part of a boot or shoe, above the sole and welt and in front of the ankle seam, that covers the instep and toes; the front part of an upper; the analogous part of a stocking.

vee.def: The name of the Latin script letter V/v.
To form something into a "v" shape, particularly as part of a welding, machining, or manufacturing process.

vie.def: To fight for superiority; to contend; to compete eagerly so as to gain something.

volta.def: A turning; a time (chiefly used in phrases signifying that the part is to be repeated).

wadi.def: A valley, gully, or stream bed in northern Africa and southwest Asia that remains dry except during the rainy season.

waiver.def: The act of waiving, or not insisting on, some right, claim, or privilege.

wean.def: To cease giving breast milk to an offspring; to accustom and reconcile (a child or young animal) to a want or deprivation of mother's milk; to take from the breast or udder.

whet.def: To hone or rub on with some substance, as a piece of stone, for the purpose of sharpening – see whetstone.

whit.def: The smallest part or particle imaginable; an iota.

wile.def: A trick or stratagem practiced for ensnaring or deception; a sly, insidious artifice

winger.def: One of the casks stowed in the wings of a vessel's hold, being smaller than such as are stowed more amidships.

winkle.def: A periwinkle or its shell, of family Littorinidae.
Synonym of winkle out (“to acquire or extract with difficulty”).

wino.def: A chronic or heavy drinker of cheap wine or other alcohol; especially, a drunkard.

wisp.def: A small bundle, as of straw or other like substance; a twisted handful of something; any slender, flexible structure or group.
To brush or dress, as with a wisp.

woe.def: Great sadness or distress; a misfortune causing such sadness.

yip.def: to bark with a sharp, high-pitched voice

yoke.def: Senses relating to a frame around the neck.
To join (several draught animals) together with a yoke; also, to fasten a yoke (on one or more draught animals) to pull a cart, plough, etc.; or to attach (a cart, plough, etc.) to a draught animal.

yucca.def: Any of several evergreen plants of the genus Yucca, having long, pointed, and rigid leaves at the top of a woody stem, and bearing a large panicle of showy white blossoms.

zag.def: One of a series of sharp turns or reversals.
To move with a sharp turn or reversal.

zig.def: A sudden or sharp turn or change of direction.

hocus.def: To play a trick on, to trick (someone); to hoax; to cheat.
A magician, illusionist, one who practises sleight of hand.

laker.def: One engaged in sport; a player; an actor.

misogynist.def: One who professes misogyny; a hater of women.
Misogynistic; relating to or exhibiting misogyny.

taffy.def: A soft, chewy candy made from boiled sugar, molasses, or corn syrup and butter.

provoke.def: To cause someone to become annoyed or angry.

bribery.def: The act of giving an illegal payment (a bribe) to a person in an official position as a means of influencing their decisions.

embroider.def: To stitch a decorative design on fabric with needle and thread of various colours.

strait.def: Narrow; restricted as to space or room; close.
A narrow channel of water connecting two larger bodies of water.

toil.def: Labour, work, especially of a grueling nature.

servile.def: An element which forms no part of the original root.

struggle.def: A contortion of the body in an attempt to escape or to perform a difficult task.
To strive, to labour in difficulty, to fight (for or against), to contend.

difficulty.def: The state of being difficult, or hard to do.

combat.def: A battle, a fight (often one in which weapons are used).

victory.def: The condition or state of having won a battle or competition, or having succeeded in an effort; (countable) an instance of this.
To defeat or triumph over (someone or something).

controversy.def: A debate or discussion of opposing opinions; (generally) strife.

opposing.def: That opposes or oppose; on the opposite side.

higher.def: A national school-leaving examination and university entrance qualification.
To make higher; to raise or increase in amount or quantity.

effort.def: The work involved in performing an activity; exertion.

achieving.def: An achievement; the process of achieving something.

exertion.def: An expenditure of physical or mental effort.

exert.def: To make use of, to apply, especially of something non-material; to bring to bear.

strength.def: The quality or degree of being strong.

muddle.def: To mix together, to mix up; to confuse.
A mixture; a confusion; a garble.

used.def: That is or has or have been used.

arrest.def: A check; a stop; an act or instance of arresting something.
To stop the motion of (a person, animal, or body part).

aught.def: At all, in any degree, in any respect.
Obsolete or dialectal form of ought

sideways.def: Moving or directed toward one side.
With a side to the front.

toward.def: Yielding, pliant; docile; ready or apt to learn; not froward.

eyeball.def: To gauge, estimate or judge by eye, rather than measuring precisely; to look or glance at.

chime.def: A musical instrument producing a sound when struck, similar to a bell (e.g. a tubular metal bar) or actually a bell. Often used in the plural to refer to the set: the chimes.
To make the sound of a chime.

pooch.def: To distend, to swell or extend beyond normal limits; usually used with out.

fuse.def: A cord that, when lit, conveys the fire to some explosive device, such as a bomb.
To furnish with or install a fuse in (an explosive device) (see Usage notes for noun above).

recharge.def: To charge an electric battery after its power has been consumed.
Water that has percolated from the ground surface to an aquifer.

manhood.def: The state or condition of being a human being.

troop.def: A collection of people; a number; a multitude (in general).
To move in numbers; to come or gather in crowds or troops.

surrender.def: To give up into the power, control, or possession of another.
An act of surrendering, submission into the possession of another; abandonment, resignation.

philosophy.def: An academic discipline that seeks truth through reasoning rather than empiricism, often attempting to provide explanations relating to general concepts such as existence and rationality.

altruism.def: Regard for others, both natural and moral without regard for oneself; devotion to the interests of others; brotherly kindness.

anathema.def: A ban or curse pronounced with religious solemnity by ecclesiastical authority, often accompanied by excommunication; something denounced as accursed.

appease.def: To make quiet; to calm; to reduce to a state of peace; to dispel (anger or hatred).

appraise.def: To determine the value or worth of (something), particularly as a person appointed for this purpose.

arbiter.def: A person appointed, or chosen, by parties to determine a controversy between them; an arbitrator.

arrogance.def: The state of being arrogant; a type of extreme or foolish pride in which someone feels much superior to another.

artful.def: Characterized by, or performed with, cleverness or contrivance; clever, ingenious.

asexual.def: Nonsexual in nature, unmarked by sexual activity.
A species which reproduces by asexual rather than sexual reproduction, or a member of such a species.

assault.def: A violent onset or attack with physical means, for example blows, weapons, etc.
To attack, physically or figuratively; to assail.

assert.def: To declare with assurance or plainly and strongly; to state positively.

assertion.def: The act of asserting; positive declaration or averment.

assumption.def: The act of assuming, or taking to or upon oneself; the act of taking up or adopting.

backer.def: One who, or that which, backs; especially one who backs an entrant in a contest, or who supports an enterprise by funding it.

bail.def: Security, usually a sum of money, exchanged for the release of an arrested person as a guarantee of that person's appearance for trial.
To secure the release of an arrested person by providing bail.

bailey.def: The outer wall of a feudal castle.

bait.def: Any substance, especially food, used in catching fish, or other animals, by alluring them to a hook, snare, trap, or net.
To attract with bait; to entice.

bale.def: Evil, especially considered as an active force for destruction or death.

banker.def: One who conducts the business of banking; one who, individually, or as a member of a company, keeps an establishment for the deposit or loan of money, or for traffic in money, bills of exchange, etc.

banner.def: A flag or standard used by a military commander, monarch or nation.

bauble.def: A cheap showy ornament or piece of jewellery; a gewgaw.

beacon.def: A signal fire to notify of the approach of an enemy, or to give any notice, commonly of warning.

beam.def: Any large piece of timber or iron long in proportion to its thickness, and prepared for use.
To emit beams of light; to shine; to radiate.

beastly.def: Pertaining to, or having the form, nature, or habits of, a beast.

behalf.def: The interest, benefit, or wellbeing of someone or something.

belay.def: To make (a rope) fast by turning it around a fastening point such as a cleat.
The securing of a rope to a rock or other sturdy object.

benevolent.def: Having a disposition to do good.

bequeath.def: To give or leave by will; to give by testament.

berserk.def: Synonym of berserker (“a Norse warrior who fought in a frenzy”).
Furiously, injuriously, or maniacally violent or out of control.

berserker.def: A Norse warrior who purportedly fought in a trance-like frenzy; a berserk.

betray.def: To deliver into the hands of an enemy by treachery or fraud, in violation of trust; to give up treacherously or faithlessly.

biologist.def: A student or professor of biology; one versed in the science of biology.

bivouac.def: An encampment for the night, usually without tents or covering.

bland.def: Having a soothing effect; not irritating or stimulating.

bleak.def: A small European river fish (Alburnus alburnus), of the family Cyprinidae.

blithe.def: Casually careless or indifferent; showing a lack of concern; nonchalant.

bluff.def: An act of bluffing; a false expression of the strength of one’s position in order to intimidate or deceive; braggadocio.
To make a bluff; to give the impression that one’s hand is stronger than it is.

blurt.def: To utter suddenly and unadvisedly; to speak quickly or without thought; to divulge inconsiderately — commonly with out.

bonanza.def: A rich mine or vein of silver or gold.

botanical.def: Of or pertaining to botany; relating to the study of plants.
Something derived from a botanical, especially herbal, source.

brace.def: To prepare for something bad, such as an impact or blow.

breach.def: A gap or opening made by breaking or battering, as in a wall, fortification or levee / embankment; the space between the parts of a solid body rent by violence.

bream.def: A European fresh-water cyprinoid fish of the genus Abramis, little valued as food. Several species are known.
To clean (e.g. a ship's bottom of clinging shells, seaweed, etc.) by the application of fire and scraping.

breech.def: A garment whose purpose is to cover or clothe the buttocks.
With the hips coming out before the head.
Born, or having been born, breech.

bridal.def: A wedding feast or festival; a wedding.
Of or pertaining to a bride, or to wedding; nuptial.

brink.def: The edge, margin, or border of a steep place, as of a precipice; a bank or edge.

brisk.def: Full of liveliness and activity; characterized by quickness of motion or action.
To make or become lively; to enliven; to animate.

brute.def: An animal seen as being without human reason; a senseless beast.
To shape (diamonds) by grinding them against each other.

buzz.def: A continuous humming noise, as of bees; a confused murmur, as of general conversation in low tones.
To make a low, continuous, humming or sibilant sound, like that made by bees with their wings.

calculation.def: The act or process of calculating.

cancellation.def: The act, process, or result of cancelling; as, the cancellation of certain words in a contract, or of the contract itself.

cape.def: A piece or point of land, extending beyond the adjacent coast into a sea or lake; a promontory; a headland.
To incite or attract (a bull) to charge a certain direction, by waving a cape.

caper.def: To leap or jump about in a sprightly or playful manner.

cater.def: Synonym of acater: an officer who purchased cates (food supplies) for the steward of a large household or estate.

caution.def: Prudence when faced with, or when expecting to face, danger; care taken in order to avoid risk or harm.
To warn; to alert, advise that caution is warranted.

cavalier.def: Lacking the proper care or concern for something important, reckless, rash, high-handed.
A military man serving on horse, (chiefly) early modern cavalry officers who had abandoned the heavy armor of medieval knights.
Of a man: to act in a gallant and dashing manner toward (women).

celebrate.def: To extol or honour in a solemn manner.

celebration.def: The formal performance of a solemn rite, such as Christian sacrament.

censure.def: The act of blaming, criticizing, or condemning as wrong; reprehension.

cessation.def: A ceasing or discontinuance, for example of an action, whether temporary or final.

champ.def: To act or behave like a champ; to endure.

char.def: To burn something to charcoal; to be burnt to charcoal.

chef.def: The presiding cook in the kitchen of a large household.
To work as a chef; to prepare and cook food professionally.

cherish.def: To treat with affection, care, and tenderness; to nurture or protect with care.

chimera.def: Any fantastic creature combining parts from different animals.

chirp.def: A short, sharp or high note or noise, as of a bird or insect.
To make a short, sharp, cheerful note, as of small birds or crickets; to chitter; to twitter.

chute.def: A framework, trough, or tube, upon or through which objects are made to slide from a higher to a lower level, or through which water passes to a wheel.

circulation.def: The act of moving in a circle, or in a course which brings the moving body to the place where its motion began.

circumstance.def: Something which is related to, or in some way affects, a fact or event.
To place in a particular situation, especially with regard to money or other resources.

circumstantial.def: Pertaining to or dependent on circumstances, especially as opposed to essentials; incidental, not essential.
Something incidental to the main subject, but of less importance.

citation.def: An official summons or notice given to a person to appear.

clamor.def: A great outcry or vociferation; loud and continued shouting or exclamation.

clang.def: A loud, ringing sound, like that made by free-hanging metal objects striking each other.
To strike (objects) together so as to produce a clang.

clarification.def: The act of freeing from obscurities; disambiguation.

classification.def: The act of forming into a class or classes; a distribution into groups, as classes, orders, families, etc., according to some common relations or attributes.

classical.def: Of or relating to the first class or rank, especially in literature or art.
One that is classical in some way; for example, a classical economist.

colossus.def: A statue of gigantic size. The name was especially applied to certain famous statues in antiquity, as the Colossus of Nero in Rome and the Colossus of Rhodes, one of the Seven Wonders of the Ancient World.

commemoration.def: The act of commemorating; an observance or celebration to honor the memory of some person or event.

commendation.def: The act of commending; praise; favorable representation in words; recommendation.

communication.def: The act or fact of communicating anything; transmission.

compensation.def: The act or principle of compensating.

compete.def: To be in battle or in a rivalry with another for the same thing, position, or reward; to contend.

compilation.def: The act or process of compiling or gathering together from various sources.

complexity.def: The state of being complex; intricacy; entanglement.

compliant.def: Willing to comply; submissive; willing to do what someone wants.

comply.def: To yield assent; to accord; to acquiesce, agree, consent; to adapt oneself, to conform.

comprise.def: To be made up of; to consist of (especially a comprehensive list of parts).

compulsory.def: Something that is compulsory or required.

computation.def: The act or process of computing; calculation; reckoning.

concede.def: To yield or suffer; to surrender; to grant

concentrate.def: To bring to, or direct toward, a common center; to unite more closely; to gather into one body, mass, or force.
A substance that is in a condensed form.

concentration.def: The act, process or ability of concentrating; the process of becoming concentrated, or the state of being concentrated.

concert.def: To plan together; to settle or adjust by conference, agreement, or consultation.
An agreement in a design or plan; a union formed by mutual communication of opinions and views; an accordance in a scheme; harmony; a simultaneous action.

condemnation.def: The act of condemning or pronouncing to be wrong.

condensation.def: The act or process of condensing or of being condensed

confer.def: To grant as a possession; to bestow.

configuration.def: The form of a thing, as depending on the relative placement of the parts of a thing's shape.

congestion.def: The hindrance or blockage of the passage of something, for example a fluid, mixture, traffic, people, etc. (due to an excess of this or due to a partial or complete obstruction), resulting in overfilling or overcrowding.

consequence.def: An effect; something that follows a cause as a result.
To threaten or punish (a child, etc.) with specific consequences for misbehaviour.

conservation.def: The act of preserving, guarding, or protecting; the keeping (of a thing) in a safe or entire state; preservation.

constipation.def: A state of the bowels in which the evacuations are infrequent and difficult, or the intestines become filled with hardened faeces.

consummation.def: The act of consummating, or the state of being consummated; the state of being completed; completion.

contamination.def: The act or process of contaminating.

contemplation.def: The act of contemplating; being highly concentrated in thought; musing.

contingent.def: An event which may or may not happen; that which is unforeseen, undetermined, or dependent on something in the future.
Possible or liable, but not certain, to occur.

continuation.def: The act or state of continuing or being continued; uninterrupted extension or succession

contrition.def: The state of being contrite; sincere penitence or remorse.

crabby.def: Relating to or resembling crabs; crablike.

cradle.def: A bed or cot for a baby, oscillating on rockers or swinging on pivots.
To contain in or as if in a cradle.

cram.def: To press, force, or drive, particularly in filling, or in thrusting one thing into another; to stuff; to fill to superfluity.
The act of cramming (forcing or stuffing something).

cranky.def: Not in good working condition; defective, faulty.

cranny.def: A small, narrow opening, fissure, crevice, or chink, as in a wall, or other substance.
To break into, or become full of, crannies.

crass.def: Coarse; crude; unrefined or insensitive; lacking discrimination or taste.

crate.def: A large open box or basket, used especially to transport fragile goods.

crater.def: A hemispherical pit created by the impact of a meteorite or other object.
To form craters in a surface.

craze.def: A strong habitual desire or fancy.
To weaken; to impair; to render decrepit.

craziness.def: The state of being crazy; madness; derangement

creak.def: The sound produced by anything that creaks; a creaking.
To make a prolonged sharp grating or squeaking sound, as by the friction of hard substances.

crease.def: A line or mark made by folding or doubling any pliable substance; hence, a similar mark, however produced.
To make a crease in; to wrinkle.

devastation.def: The act of devastating, or the state of being devastated; a laying waste.
