A record pressed again; a repressing.

reprimand.def: A severe, formal or official reproof; reprehension, rebuke, private or public.
To reprove in a formal or official way.

require.def: To demand, to insist upon (having); to call for authoritatively.

resemblance.def: The quality or state of resembling.

resent.def: To feel resentment over; to consider as an affront.

reside.def: To dwell permanently or for a considerable time; to have a settled abode for a time; to remain for a long time.

result.def: To proceed, spring up or rise, as a consequence, from facts, arguments, premises, combination of circumstances, consultation, thought or endeavor.
That which results; the conclusion or end to which any course or condition of things leads, or which is obtained by any process or operation; consequence or effect.

retaliation.def: Violent or otherwise punitive response to an act of harm or perceived injustice; a hitting back; revenge.

retire.def: To stop working on a permanent basis, usually because of old age or illness.
The act of retiring, or the state of being retired.

revert.def: One who, or that which, reverts.
To turn back, or turn to the contrary; to reverse.

revise.def: To review, alter and amend, especially of written material.

revival.def: The act of reviving, or the state of being revived.

revive.def: To cause (a person or animal) to recover from a faint; to cause (a person or animal) to return to a state of consciousness.
Synonym of revival (“an act of reviving, or a state of being revived (in various senses)”).

rife.def: Widespread, common, prevalent, current (mainly of unpleasant or harmful things).

rigorous.def: Showing, causing, or favoring rigour/rigor; scrupulously accurate or strict; thorough.

riot.def: A tumultuous disturbance of the public peace by a large group of people, often involving violence or damage to property.
To create or take part in a riot; to raise an uproar or sedition.

ripe.def: Of a fruit, vegetable, seed, etc., ready for reaping or gathering; having attained perfection; mature.
A fruit or vegetable which has ripened.

rocky.def: Abounding in, or full of, rocks; consisting of rocks.

rosette.def: An element or ornament resembling a rose, especially on a wall or other surface, mostly for decorative purposes.

roulette.def: A game of chance in which a small ball is made to move round rapidly on a circle divided off into numbered (usually red and black) spaces. When the ball stops, it indicates the result of a variety of wagers permitted by the game.
To separate or decorate by incisions made with a small toothed wheel.

rout.def: A group of people; a crowd, a throng, a troop; in particular (archaic), a group of people accompanying or travelling with someone.
To assemble in a crowd, whether orderly or disorderly; to collect in company.

route.def: A course or way which is traveled or passed.
To direct or divert along a particular course.

rugged.def: Broken into sharp or irregular points; uneven; not smooth; rough.

ruthless.def: Without pity or compassion; cruel, pitiless.

sacrosanct.def: Beyond alteration, criticism, or interference, especially due to religious sanction; inviolable.

sag.def: The state of sinking or bending; a droop.
To sink, in the middle, by its weight or under applied pressure, below a horizontal line or plane.

sailor.def: A person who sails; one whose occupation is sailing or navigating ships or other waterborne craft.

saliva.def: A clear, slightly alkaline liquid secreted into the mouth by the salivary glands and mucous glands, consisting of water, mucin, protein, and enzymes. It moistens the mouth, lubricates ingested food, and begins the breakdown of starches.

sane.def: Being in a healthy condition; not deranged; thinking rationally.
Ellipsis of SANE disc, a type of black hole accretion disc.

sapling.def: A young tree, larger than a seedling.

sarcasm.def: Use of acerbic language to mock or convey contempt, often using verbal irony and (in speech) often marked by overemphasis and sneering.

scabby.def: Affected with scabs; full of scabs.

scan.def: To examine sequentially, carefully, or critically; to scrutinize; to behold closely.

scene.def: The location of an event that attracts attention.
To exhibit as a scene; to make a scene of; to display.

scoff.def: A derisive or mocking expression of scorn, contempt, or reproach.
To jeer; to laugh with contempt and derision.

scoot.def: A sideways shuffling or sliding motion.
To walk or travel fast; to go quickly.

scout.def: A person sent out to gather and bring back information; especially, one employed in war to gain information about the enemy and ground.
To explore a wide terrain, as if on a search.

scowl.def: The wrinkling of the brows or face in frowning; the expression of displeasure, sullenness, or discontent in the countenance; an angry frown.
To wrinkle the brows, as in frowning or displeasure; to put on a frowning look; to look sour, sullen, severe, or angry.

scrappy.def: Consisting of scraps; fragmentary; lacking unity or consistency.

scribble.def: To write or draw carelessly and in a hurry.
Careless, hasty writing, doodle or drawing

scribe.def: Someone who writes; a draughtsperson; a writer for another; especially, an official or public writer; an amanuensis, secretary, notary, or copyist.

scythe.def: An instrument for mowing grass, grain, etc. by hand, composed of a long, curving blade with a sharp concave edge, fastened to a long handle called a snath.

secondary.def: Next in order to the first or primary; of second place in origin, rank, etc.
Any flight feather attached to the ulna (forearm) of a bird.

segregation.def: The act of setting apart and organizing things based upon their characteristics.

selflessness.def: The quality or state of being selfless.

serve.def: An act of putting the ball or shuttlecock in play in various games.
To provide a service (or, by extension, a product, especially food or drink).

server.def: A program that provides services to other programs or devices, either in the same computer or over a computer network.

setback.def: An obstacle, delay, disadvantage, or blow (an adverse event which slows down, or prevents progress towards a desired outcome).

settee.def: A long seat with a back, made to accommodate several persons at once; a sofa.

shabby.def: Of clothing, a place, etc.: unkempt and worn or otherwise in poor condition due to age or neglect; scruffy.
To make (something) shabby (adjective sense 1); to shabbify.

shack.def: A crude, roughly built hut or cabin.
To live (in or with); to shack up.

shaker.def: A person or thing that shakes, or by means of which something is shaken.
Pertaining to a distinctive style of furniture developed by the Shakers, characterised by functionality and minimalist designs.

sheen.def: Beautiful, good-looking, attractive, fair; bright, radiant; shiny.

shell.def: A hard external covering of an animal.
To remove the outer covering or shell of something.

shorthand.def: A rough and rapid method of writing by substituting symbols for letters, words, etc.
To render (spoken or written words) into shorthand.

shopkeeper.def: A trader who sells goods in a shop, or by retail, in distinction from one who sells by wholesale, or sells door to door.

shout.def: A loud burst of voice or voices; a violent and sudden outcry, especially that of a multitude expressing joy, triumph, exultation, anger, or great effort.
To utter a sudden and loud cry, as in joy, triumph, exultation or anger, or to attract attention, to animate others, etc.

shortly.def: In a short or brief time or manner; quickly.

shred.def: A fragment of something; a particle; a piece; also, a very small amount.
To cut or tear (something) into long, narrow pieces or strips.
Synonym of shredded (“cut or torn into narrow strips or small pieces”).

shroud.def: That which clothes, covers, conceals, or protects; a garment.

shy.def: To avoid due to caution, embarrassment or timidness.

siesta.def: A nap, especially an afternoon one taken during the hottest part of the day in some cultures.
to take a siesta; to nap.

sigh.def: To inhale a larger quantity of air than usual, and immediately expel it; to make a deep single audible respiration, especially as the result or involuntary expression of fatigue, exhaustion, grief, sorrow, frustration, or the like.
A deep, prolonged audible inhale and exhale of breath; as when fatigued, frustrated, grieved, or relieved; the act of sighing.

silhouette.def: The outline of a garment as it appears on the wearer.
To represent by a silhouette; to project upon a background, so as to be like a silhouette.

simply.def: In a simple way or state; considered in or by itself; without addition; alone.

site.def: The place where anything is fixed; situation; local position
To situate or place a building or construction project.

skate.def: A runner or blade, usually of steel, with a frame shaped to fit the sole of a shoe, made to be fastened under the foot, and used for gliding on ice.
To move along a surface (ice or ground) using skates.
Pertaining to the technique of skating.

skimp.def: To mock, deride, scorn, scold, make fun of.
A skimpy or insubstantial thing, especially a piece of clothing.

slack.def: The part of anything that hangs loose, having no strain upon it.
Lax; not tense; not firmly extended.

slam.def: To shut with sudden force so as to produce a shock and noise.

slap.def: A blow, especially one given with the open hand, or with something broad and flat.
To strike someone, typically with an open hand, often on the face.

slapper.def: One who, or that which, slaps.

slater.def: One who lays slates, or whose occupation is to slate buildings.

slayer.def: A killer; a murderer; someone who slays.

sled.def: A small, light vehicle with runners, used recreationally, mostly by children, for sliding down snow-covered hills; no draft animal pulls it.

sleek.def: Having an even, smooth surface; smooth
To make smooth or glossy; to polish.

sleigh.def: A vehicle, generally pulled by an animal, which moves over snow or ice on runners, used for transporting persons or goods. (contrast "sled", which is smaller)
To ride or drive a sleigh.

slice.def: That which is thin and broad.
Having the properties of a slice knot.

slight.def: To treat as unimportant or not worthy of attention; to make light of.
The act of ignoring or snubbing; a deliberate act of neglect or discourtesy.

slime.def: Soft, moist earth or clay, having an adhesive quality; viscous mud; any substance of a dirty nature, that is moist, soft, and adhesive; bitumen; mud containing metallic ore, obtained in the preparatory dressing.

sliver.def: A long piece cut or rent off; a sharp, slender fragment.
To cut or divide into long, thin pieces, or into very small pieces; to cut or rend lengthwise; to slit.

slouch.def: A hanging down of the head; a drooping posture; a limp appearance
To hang or droop; to adopt a limp posture

smack.def: A distinct flavor, especially if slight.
As if with a smack or slap; smartly; sharply.

snag.def: A stump or base of a branch that has been lopped off; a short branch, or a sharp or rough branch.
To catch or tear (e.g. fabric) upon a rough surface or projection.

snap.def: A quick breaking or cracking sound or the action of producing such a sound.
To fracture or break apart suddenly.
Done, made, performed, etc., quickly and unexpectedly, or without deliberation.

snarl.def: To entangle; to complicate; to involve in knots.
A knot or complication of hair, thread, or the like, difficult to disentangle.

sneak.def: One who sneaks; one who moves stealthily to acquire an item or information.
To creep or go stealthily; to come or go while trying to avoid detection, as a person who does not wish to be seen.
In advance; before release to the general public.

snide.def: Disparaging or derisive in an insinuative way.
An underhanded, tricky person given to sharp practice; a sharper; a cheat.

snipe.def: Any of various limicoline game birds of the genera Gallinago, Lymnocryptes and Coenocorypha in the family Scolopacidae, having a long, slender, nearly straight beak.

snout.def: The long, projecting nose, mouth, and jaw of a beast, as of pigs.
To furnish with a nozzle or point.

solitary.def: One who lives alone, or in solitude; an anchorite, hermit or recluse.
Living or being by oneself; alone; having no companion present

span.def: The full width of an open hand from the end of the thumb to the end of the little finger used as an informal unit of length.
To extend through the distance between or across.

spare.def: The act of sparing; moderation; restraint.
To show mercy, to have mercy on.

sparkle.def: To emit sparks; to throw off ignited or incandescent particles

spate.def: A (sudden) flood or inundation of water; specifically, a flood in or overflow of a river or other watercourse due to heavy rain or melting snow; (uncountable, archaic) flooding, inundation.
To (suddenly) flood or inundate (a river or other watercourse) with water.

spectacle.def: An exciting or extraordinary scene, exhibition, performance etc.

spike.def: A sort of very large nail.
To fasten with spikes, or long, large nails.

spire.def: The stalk or stem of a plant.
to sprout, to send forth the early shoots of growth; to germinate.

splendid.def: Possessing or displaying splendor; shining; very bright.

splice.def: A junction or joining of ropes made by splicing them together.
To unite, as two ropes, or parts of a rope, by a particular manner of interweaving the strands, the union being between two ends, or between an end and the body of a rope.

sprain.def: To weaken, as a joint, ligament, or muscle, by sudden and excessive exertion, as by wrenching; to overstrain, or stretch injuriously, but without luxation
The act or result of spraining; lameness caused by spraining

sprite.def: Any of various supernatural beings, loosely defined:
To draw a (specifically) pixel art sprite.

spry.def: Having great power of leaping or running; nimble; active.

spurt.def: To cause to gush out suddenly or violently in a stream or jet.
A brief gush, as of liquid spurting from an orifice or a cut/wound.

squaw.def: A woman, wife; especially a Native American woman.

squire.def: A shield-bearer or armor-bearer who attended a knight.

squirt.def: An instrument from which a liquid is forcefully ejected in a small, quick stream.
To be thrown out, or ejected, in a rapid stream, from a narrow orifice.

stack.def: To arrange in a stack, or to add to an existing stack.

stadium.def: A venue where sporting events are held.

stag.def: An adult male deer, especially a red deer and especially one in high adulthood versus a young adult.
To act as a "stag", an irregular dealer in stocks.
Of a man, attending a formal social function without a date.

stagger.def: An unsteady movement of the body in walking or standing as if one were about to fall; a reeling motion.
To sway unsteadily, reel, or totter.

starch.def: Carbohydrates, as with grain and potato based foods.
To apply or treat with laundry starch, in order to create a hard, smooth surface.

startle.def: To move suddenly, or be excited, on feeling alarm; to start.
A sudden motion or shock caused by an unexpected alarm, surprise, or apprehension of danger.

statistic.def: A single item in a statistical study.
To analyze or describe using statistics.

statuette.def: A small statue, usually a figure much less than life size, especially when of marble or bronze, or of plaster or clay as a preparation for the marble or bronze, as distinguished from a figure in terra cotta etc.

stave.def: One of a number of narrow strips of wood, or narrow iron plates, placed edge to edge to form the sides, covering, or lining of a vessel or structure; especially, one of the strips which form the sides of a cask, barrel, pail, etc.
To fit or furnish with staves or rundles.

stead.def: The position or function (of someone or something), as taken on by a successor.
To help, support, benefit or assist; to be helpful.

steak.def: Beefsteak: a slice of beef, broiled or cut for broiling.
To cook (something, especially fish) like or as a steak.

steed.def: A stallion, especially one used for riding.

steep.def: Of a near-vertical gradient; of a slope, surface, curve, etc. that proceeds upward at an angle near vertical.
The steep side of a mountain etc.; a slope or acclivity.

stent.def: A slender tube inserted into a blood vessel, a ureter or the oesophagus in order to provide support and to prevent disease-induced closure.
To insert a stent or tube into a blood vessel.

stingy.def: Unwilling to spend, give, or share; ungenerous; mean.

stout.def: A dark and strong malt brew made with toasted grain.

stray.def: Any domestic animal that lacks an enclosure, proper place, or company, but that instead wanders at large or is lost; an estray.
To wander, as from a direct course; to deviate, or go out of the way.

straightforward.def: Proceeding in a straight course or manner; not deviating.
In a straightforward manner; straightforwards; straightforwardly.

strengthen.def: To make strong or stronger; to add strength to; to increase the strength of; to fortify.

stringent.def: Strict; binding strongly; making strict requirements; restrictive; rigid; severe.

stroll.def: A wandering on foot; an idle and leisurely walk; a ramble; a saunter.
To wander on foot; to ramble idly or leisurely; to rove.

sty.def: A pen or enclosure for swine.
To place in, or as if in, a sty.

subscribe.def: To write (one’s name) at the bottom of a document; to sign (one's name).

subside.def: To sink or fall to the bottom; to settle, as lees.

subvert.def: To overturn from the foundation; to overthrow; to ruin utterly.

succeed.def: To follow something in sequence or time.

successful.def: Resulting in success; assuring or promoting success; accomplishing what was proposed; having the desired effect.

suffice.def: To be enough or sufficient; to meet the need (of anything); to be adequate; to be good enough.

sufficient.def: Of a type or kind that suffices, that satisfies requirements or needs.

suite.def: A group or train of attendants, servants etc.; a retinue.

sunflower.def: Any plant of the genus Helianthus, so called probably from the form and color of its floral head, having the form of a large disk surrounded by yellow ray flowers.

surmise.def: Thought, imagination, or conjecture, which may be based upon feeble or scanty evidence; suspicion; guess.
To imagine or suspect; to conjecture; to posit with contestable premises.

moderate.def: One who holds an intermediate position between extremes, as in politics.

surplus.def: That which remains when use or need is satisfied, or when a limit is reached; excess; overplus; overage.
Being or constituting a surplus; more than sufficient.
To treat as surplus to requirements; to sell off or dismiss from employment, etc.

swagger.def: To behave (especially to walk or carry oneself) in a pompous, superior manner.

swain.def: A young man or boy in service; a servant.

sway.def: The act of swaying; a swaying motion; a swing or sweep of a weapon.
To move or swing from side to side; or backward and forward; to rock.

excessive.def: Exceeding the usual bounds of something; too much (of amount); extravagant; immoderate.

swerve.def: To stray; to wander; to rove.
A sudden movement out of a straight line, for example to avoid a collision.

swipe.def: A quick grab, bat, or other motion with the hand or paw; a sweep.

extravagant.def: Exceeding the bounds of something; roving; hence, foreign.

exorbitant.def: Exceeding proper limits; excessive or unduly high; extravagant.

shameless.def: Having no shame, no guilt nor remorse over something considered wrong; immodest, brazen; unable to feel disgrace.

modesty.def: The quality of being modest; having a limited and not overly high opinion of oneself and one's abilities.

lewd.def: A sexually suggestive image, particularly one which does not involve full nudity.
To express lust; to behave in a lewd manner.

lascivious.def: Wanton; lewd, driven by lust, lustful.

lustful.def: Full of lust; driven by lust.

marble.def: A metamorphic rock of crystalline limestone.
To cause (something to have) the streaked or swirled appearance of certain types of marble, for example by mixing viscous ingredients incompletely, or by applying paint or other colorants unevenly.

recluse.def: A person who lives in self-imposed isolation or seclusion from the world, especially for religious purposes; a hermit.

shaggy.def: Having long, thick, and uncombed hair, fur or wool.

shale.def: A shell, scale or husk; a cod or pod.
To take off the shell or coat of.

shriek.def: A sharp, shrill outcry or scream; a shrill wild cry caused by sudden or extreme terror, pain, or the like.
To utter a loud, sharp, shrill sound or cry, as do some birds and beasts; to scream, as in a sudden fright, in horror or anguish.

tabby.def: A kind of waved silk, usually called watered silk, manufactured like taffeta, but thicker and stronger. The watering is given to it by calendering.
Having a wavy or watered appearance.
To give a wavy or watered appearance to (a textile).

tact.def: To use a tact (a kind of verbal operant).

taint.def: A contamination, decay or putrefaction, especially in food.
To contaminate or corrupt (something) with an external agent, either physically or morally.

tally.def: One of two books, sheets of paper, etc., on which corresponding accounts were kept.
In a tall way; stoutly; with spirit.

tammy.def: A kind of woolen, or woolen and cotton, cloth, often highly glazed, used for curtains, sieves, strainers, etc.

tang.def: A refreshingly sharp aroma or flavor.
To strike two metal objects together loudly in order to persuade a swarm of honeybees to land so it may be captured by the beekeeper.

tanner.def: A person whose occupation is to tan hides, or convert them into leather by the use of tan.

tart.def: Sharp to the taste; acid; sour.

A type of small open pie, or piece of pastry, now typically containing jelly (US) / jam (UK) or conserve, or sometimes other fillings (chocolate, custard, egg, butter, historically even meat or other savory fillings).

tasty.def: Having a pleasant or satisfying flavor.
Something tasty; a delicious article of food.

teak.def: An extremely durable timber highly valued for shipbuilding and other purposes, yielded by Tectona grandis (and Tectona spp.).
Of a yellowish brown colour, like that of teak wood.

telegraph.def: Synonym of telegraphy, any process for transmitting arbitrarily long messages over a long distance using a symbolic code.
To use a telegraph; to send a message by telegraph.

telepathy.def: The capability to communicate directly by psychic means; the sympathetic affection of one mind by the thoughts, feelings, or emotions of another at a distance, without communication through the ordinary channels of sensation.

temperance.def: Habitual moderation in regard to the indulgence of the natural appetites and passions; restrained or moderate indulgence.

tenacity.def: The quality or state of being tenacious, or persistence of purpose; tenaciousness.

tend.def: To make a tender of; to offer or tender.

tent.def: A pavilion or portable lodge consisting of skins, canvas, or some strong cloth, stretched and sustained by poles, used for sheltering people from the weather.

tentative.def: A trial; an experiment; an attempt.
Of or pertaining to a trial or trials; essaying; experimental.

terminology.def: A treatise on terms, especially those used in a specialised field.

thane.def: A rank of nobility in pre-Norman England, roughly equivalent to baron.

thirst.def: A sensation of dryness in the throat associated with a craving for liquids, produced by deprivation of drink, or by some other cause (such as fear, excitement, etc.) which stops the secretion of the pharyngeal mucous membrane.

thrive.def: To grow or increase stature; to grow vigorously or luxuriantly; to enjoy a state of excellent health and well-being; to flourish.

thyme.def: Any plant of the labiate genus Thymus, such as garden thyme (Thymus vulgaris), a warm, pungent aromatic, that is much used to give a relish to seasoning and soups.

toot.def: The noise of a horn or whistle.
To stand out, or be prominent.

toupee.def: A wig of false hair worn to cover a bald spot, especially as worn by a man.

towel.def: A cloth used for wiping, especially one used for drying anything wet, such as a person after a bath.
To dry by using a towel.

track.def: A mark left by something that has passed along.

tracker.def: Agent noun of track; one who, or that which, tracks or pursues, as a man or dog that follows game.

traditional.def: Of, relating to, or derived from tradition.

traitor.def: Someone who takes arms and levies war against their country; or one who aids an enemy in conquering their country.
To act the traitor toward; to betray; to deceive.

transcript.def: Something which has been transcribed; a writing or composition consisting of the same words as the original; a written copy.
To write a transcript; to transcribe.

trapeze.def: To swing on or as on a trapeze.

trapper.def: One who traps animals; one who makes a business of trapping animals, for their pelts, meat, etc.

treacle.def: A syrupy byproduct of sugar refining; molasses or golden syrup.
To apply treacle to a surface, so as to catch flies or moths, etc.

treadmill.def: A piece of indoor sporting equipment used to allow for the motions of running or walking while staying in one place.

treat.def: To negotiate, discuss terms, bargain (for or with).
An entertainment, outing, food, drink, or other indulgence provided by someone for the enjoyment of others.

trend.def: An inclination in a particular direction.
To have a particular direction; to run; to stretch; to tend.

tripe.def: The lining of the large stomach of ruminating animals, when prepared for food.

triumph.def: A conclusive success following an effort, conflict, or confrontation of obstacles; victory; conquest.
To celebrate victory with pomp; to rejoice over success; to exult in an advantage gained; to exhibit exultation.

troll.def: a giant supernatural being, especially a grotesque humanoid creature living in caves or hills or under bridges.
Senses relating to a rolling motion.

trowel.def: A mason’s tool, used in spreading and dressing mortar, and breaking bricks to shape them.
To apply (a substance) with a trowel.

trustee.def: A person to whom property is legally committed in trust, to be applied either for the benefit of specified individuals (beneficiaries), or for public uses; one who is intrusted with property for the benefit of another.
To commit (property) to the care of a trustee.

tumbleweed.def: Any plant which habitually breaks away from its roots once dry, forming a light, rolling mass which is driven by the wind from place to place; as Russian thistle, wild indigo, witch grass, Amaranthus albus, etc.

tutelage.def: The act of guarding, protecting, or guiding.

tweak.def: To pinch and pull with a sudden jerk and twist; to twitch.
A sharp pinch or jerk; a twist or twitch.

twinge.def: To have a sudden, pinching or sharp pain in a specific part of the body, like a twitch.
A sudden, pinching or sharp pain in a specific part of the body, especially one lasting for a short time.

unborn.def: Not yet born; yet to come; future.
A single unborn offspring at any stage of gestation.

uncanny.def: Strange, and mysteriously unsettling (as if supernatural); weird.
Something that is simultaneously familiar and strange, typically leading to feelings of discomfort.

unearth.def: To drive or draw from the earth.

unhand.def: To release from the hand; to let go.

unkind.def: Lacking kindness, sympathy, benevolence, gratitude, or similar; cruel, harsh or unjust; ungrateful.

unleash.def: To free from a leash, or as from a leash.

unlike.def: Not like; dissimilar (to); having no resemblance; unalike.
Something that is not like something else; something different.

unlikely.def: Not likely; improbable; not to be reasonably expected.

unseen.def: An examination involving material not previously seen or studied.

untie.def: To loosen, as something interlaced or knotted; to disengage the parts of.

untold.def: Not told; not related; not revealed; secret.

unwell.def: Not in good health; not feeling well; somewhat ill

unwrap.def: To open or undo, as what is wrapped or folded.

uproot.def: To tear up (a plant, etc.) by the roots, or as if by the roots; to extirpate, to root up.

urgency.def: The quality or condition of being urgent.

vassal.def: The grantee of a fief, a subordinate granted use of a superior's land and its income in exchange for vows of fidelity and homage and (typically) military service.
To treat as a vassal or to reduce to the position of a vassal; to subject to control; to enslave.

veal.def: The flesh of a calf (i.e. a young bovine) used for food.
To raise a calf for meat production.

veil.def: Something hung up or spread out to hide or protect the face, or hide an object from view; usually of gauze, crepe, or similar diaphanous material.
To dress in, or decorate with, a veil.

vestal.def: Of or pertaining to Vesta, the virgin goddess of the hearth.
A virgin consecrated to Vesta, and to the service of watching the sacred fire, which was to be perpetually kept burning upon her altar; a vestal virgin.

vicariously.def: In a vicarious manner; indirectly; as, by, or through a substitute; by proxy.

vinaigrette.def: A sauce, made of an acidic liquid such as vinegar or lemon juice; oil; and other ingredients, used as a salad dressing, or as a marinade for cold meats.

volcanic.def: Of or pertaining to a volcano or volcanoes.

volunteer.def: One who enters into, or offers themselves for, any service of their own free will, especially when done without pay.
To enlist oneself as a volunteer.

vow.def: A solemn promise to perform some act, or behave in a specified manner, especially a promise to live and act in accordance with the rules of a religious order.
To make a vow; to promise.

wager.def: A bet; a stake; a pledge.

Someone who is present; a bystander, a witness.

thirsty.def: Needing to drink water or any liquid that can supply water.
One who is thirsty (for a drink, sex, alcohol, etc.).

armchair.def: A chair with supports for the arms or elbows.
Remote from actual involvement, including a person retired from previously active involvement.
To create based on theory or general knowledge rather than data.

untidy.def: To make untidy, to make a mess

favourite.def: Most-liked. (In other words, [person]'s favorite [noun] = the [noun] that [person] likes the most.)
A person or thing who enjoys special regard or favour.

terrible.def: Dreadful; causing terror, alarm and fear; awesome
In a terrible way; to a terrible extent; terribly; awfully.

biscuit.def: A small, flat, baked good which is either hard and crisp or else soft but firm; a cookie.
To fire (pottery) in a kiln, without a ceramic glaze.

butcher.def: A person who prepares and sells meat (and sometimes also slaughters the animals).
To slaughter (animals) and prepare (meat) for market.

assist.def: A helpful action or an act of giving.

housework.def: domestic household chores such as cleaning and cooking

artillery.def: Large projectile weapons, in modern usage usually large guns, but also rocket artillery.

queasy.def: Experiencing or causing nausea or uneasiness, often characterized by an unsettled stomach.

gunnery.def: The science of guns and gunfire, including aspects of bullet flight and impact.

mailman.def: Someone who delivers mail to, and/or collects mail from, residential or commercial addresses, or from public mailboxes.

tracheotomy.def: A surgical procedure in which an incision is made into the trachea, through the neck, and a tube inserted so as to make an artificial opening in order to assist breathing.

aerosol.def: A mixture of fine solid particles or liquid droplets suspended in a gaseous medium.

ooze.def: Tanning liquor, an aqueous extract of vegetable matter (tanbark, sumac, etc.) in a tanning vat used to tan leather.
To be secreted or slowly leak.

administrative.def: Of or relating to administering or administration.

zone.def: Any given region or area of the world.
To divide into or assign to sections or areas.

upright.def: In or into an upright position.
Any vertical part of a structure.

donna.def: A lady, especially a noblewoman; the title given to a lady in Italy.

erotic.def: Relating to or tending to arouse sexual desire or excitement.

erotica.def: Erotic literature, art, decoration, or other such work.

kazoo.def: A simple musical instrument (a membranophone) consisting of a pipe with a hole in it, producing a buzzing sound when the player hums into it.

phonograph.def: A device that captures sound waves onto an engraved archive; a lathe.
To record for playback by phonograph.

career.def: One’s calling in life; one's working occupation or profession, especially when pursued seriously or over a long period of time.
To move rapidly straight ahead, especially in an uncontrolled way.
Doing something professionally, for a living (generally said of something that is not a commonplace job, e.g. criminal activity).

ute.def: A small vehicle based on the same platform as a family car but with a unibody construction and a built-in open tray area for carrying goods; similar but not identical to a pick-up truck.

jettison.def: Items that have been or are about to be ejected from a boat or balloon.

loser.def: A person who loses; one who fails to win or thrive.

tactile.def: Tangible; perceptible to the sense of touch.

signature.def: A person's name, written by that person, used as identification or to signify approval of accompanying material, such as a legal contract.
To sign with one's signature, to write one's signature on.

autograph.def: A person’s own handwriting, especially the signature of a famous or admired person.
Written in the author’s own handwriting.
To sign, or write one’s name or signature on a book, etc.

pickle.def: A cucumber preserved in a solution, usually a brine or a vinegar syrup.
To preserve food (or sometimes other things) in a salt, sugar or vinegar solution.

stigma.def: An indication of infamy or disgrace.

viscous.def: Having a thick, sticky consistency between solid and liquid (that is, a high viscosity).

vivacious.def: Lively and animated; full of life and energy.

hopeful.def: Someone who is hoping for success or victory, especially as a candidate in a political election.

tyrant.def: A usurper; one who gains power and rules extralegally, distinguished from kings elevated by election or succession.
Tyrannical, tyrannous; like, characteristic of, or in the manner of a tyrant.
To act like a tyrant; to be tyrannical.

tyranny.def: A government in which a single ruler (a tyrant) has absolute power, or this system of government; especially, one that acts cruelly and unjustly.

trauma.def: Any serious injury to the body, often resulting from violence or an accident.

tragedy.def: A drama or similar work, in which the main character is brought to ruin or otherwise suffers the extreme consequences of some tragic flaw or weakness of character.

therapy.def: Attempted remediation of a health problem following a diagnosis, usually synonymous with treatment.

telekinesis.def: The ability to move objects with the power of one's mind.

taxidermy.def: The art of stuffing and mounting the skins of dead animals for exhibition in a lifelike state.

luau.def: An elaborate Hawaiian feast featuring traditional foods and entertainment.

kahuna.def: A priest or priestess of the traditional Hawaiian religion.

hula.def: A form of chant and dance, which was developed in the Hawaiian Islands by the Polynesians who originally settled there.

aerodynamics.def: The science of the dynamics of bodies moving relative to gases, especially the interaction of moving objects with the atmosphere.

aeronautics.def: The design, construction, mathematics, and mechanics of aircraft and other flying objects; the study of and control of how aviation works.

ambrosia.def: The food of the gods, thought to confer immortality.

anorexia.def: Loss of appetite, especially as a result of disease.

asphyxia.def: Loss of consciousness due to the interruption of breathing and consequent anoxia.

asparagus.def: Any of various perennial plants of the genus Asparagus having leaflike stems, scalelike leaves, and small flowers.

arithmetic.def: The mathematics of numbers (integers, rational numbers, real numbers, or complex numbers) under the operations of addition, subtraction, multiplication, and division.
Increasing or decreasing by an arithmetic progression.

aphrodisiac.def: Something, generally a food or drug, having such an effect.

polka.def: A lively dance originating in Bohemia.

kaleidoscope.def: An instrument consisting of a tube containing mirrors and loose, colourful beads or other objects; when the tube is looked into and rotated, a succession of symmetrical designs can be seen.

lamp.def: A device that generates heat, light or other radiation. Especially an electric light bulb.

logos.def: A form of rhetoric in which the writer or speaker uses logical argument as the main form of persuasion.

lymphoma.def: A malignant tumor that arises in the lymph nodes or in other lymphoid tissue.

lyric.def: Of, or relating to a type of poetry (such as a sonnet or ode) that expresses subjective thoughts and feelings, often in a songlike style.

narcolepsy.def: A disorder characterized by sudden and uncontrollable attacks of deep sleep, often brief, sometimes accompanied by paralysis and hallucinations.

necrosis.def: The localized death of cells or tissues through injury, disease, or the interruption of blood supply.

neurology.def: The branch of medicine that deals with the disorders of nervous system including the brain and spinal cord of the central nervous system and the nerves, muscles, and neuromuscular junction of the peripheral nervous system.

rhapsody.def: An epic poem, or part of one, suitable for uninterrupted recitation.

scheme.def: An artful deviation from the ordinary arrangement of words.

satyr.def: A sylvan deity or demigod, male companion of Pan or Dionysus, represented as part man and part goat, and characterized by riotous merriment and lasciviousness, sometimes pictured with a perpetual erection.

stereotype.def: A conventional, formulaic, and often oversimplified or exaggerated conception, opinion, or image of (a person or a group of people).

stethoscope.def: A medical instrument used for listening to sounds produced within the body.

strategy.def: The science and art of military command as applied to the overall planning and conduct of warfare.

symbiosis.def: A relationship of mutual benefit, especially among different species.

symphony.def: An extended piece of music of sophisticated structure, usually for orchestra.

bris.def: Ritual male circumcision; the ceremony in which this is performed.

chutzpah.def: Nearly arrogant courage; utter audacity, effrontery or impudence; supreme self-confidence; exaggerated self-opinion.

spiel.def: A lengthy and extravagant speech or argument usually intended to persuade.

barometer.def: An instrument for measuring atmospheric pressure.

genesis.def: The origin, start, or point at which something comes into being.

gloss.def: To give a gloss or sheen to.

diabolical.def: Of or concerning the devil: devilish, satanic.

diploma.def: A document issued by an educational institution testifying that the recipient has earned a degree or has successfully completed a particular course of study.

ethos.def: The character or fundamental values of a person, people, culture, or movement.

cleopatra.def: A woman of great seductive beauty.

odyssey.def: An extended adventurous voyage, usually in search of home.
